title: Everyday Phrases — Eating at a Sushi Bar
scene_zh: 回轉壽司吃一頓 · 情境對話
title_quote: Good evening, a seat for four people.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🍣 實用「回轉壽司」必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡800句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 800 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Eating at a Sushi Bar
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「回轉壽司」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是星期五晚上的壽司吧台：開場先要一個四個人的位子、坐進吧台要一壺熱茶、看盤子顏色算價位（白盤兩元、黑盤四元、藍盤五元、金盤八元）、學著用手拿也學用筷子、請師傅在魚肉上多抹一點山葵、問清楚哪一貫含蛋、哪幾盤是全熟的、數一數空盤來結帳、剩下的能不能裝盒打包、最後在門口對師傅說一句真的好吃。800 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。常用句型包含找座位、點餐、詢問蛋與過敏、數盤結帳、打包與道別。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'Eating at a Sushi Bar' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). The scene is a sushi counter on a Friday night: asking for a seat for four people, taking the stool and ordering a pot of tea, reading the price off the plate colour (white two, black four, blue five, gold eight), learning to pick the nigiri up by hand or with chopsticks, asking the chef for more wasabi on the fish, checking which rolls hold egg and which plates are fully cooked, counting the empty plates at the till, asking whether the leftovers can be boxed, and saying one honest compliment to the chef at the door. 800 lines on repeat, A2 level, easy to repeat out loud even from zero.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good evening, a seat for four people.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈivnɪŋ ə sit fɔr fɔr ˈpipəl/
dialogue.zh: 晚上好，要四個人的位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two adults and two kids? This end is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu əˈdʌlts ænd tu kɪdz ðɪs ɛnd ɪz fri/
dialogue.zh: 兩個大人、兩個小孩？這一端還空著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the table by the window still free?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈteɪbəl baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ stɪl fri?/
dialogue.zh: 靠窗那張桌子還空著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one is taken, but this stool is open.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn ɪz ˈteɪkən bʌt ðɪs stul ɪz ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 那張有人了，不過這個座位是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I can watch the whole fish board.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt aɪ kæn wɑtʃ ðə hoʊl fɪʃ bɔrd/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我可以看整塊切魚板。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I left this end open for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lɛft ðɪs ɛnd ˈoʊpən fɔr ju/
dialogue.zh: 我特地幫你們留了這一端。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we start with some hot tea?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd wi stɑrt wɪð sʌm hɑt ti/
dialogue.zh: 可以先幫我們上熱茶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have hot tea or iced tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv hɑt ti ɔr aɪst ti/
dialogue.zh: 我們有熱茶或冰茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hot tea, please, this room feels cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑt ti pliz ðɪs rum filz koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 熱茶，麻煩了，這個房間有點冷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hot pot, it comes in a second.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn hɑt pɑt ɪt kʌmz ɪn ə ˈsɛkənd/
dialogue.zh: 一壺熱的，這就來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this cool towel for our hands?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs kul ˈtaʊəl fɔr ˈaʊər hændz/
dialogue.zh: 這條涼毛巾是給我們擦手的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, wipe first, the walk made them dusty.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs waɪp fɜrst ðə wɔk meɪd ðɛm ˈdʌsti/
dialogue.zh: 是的，先擦一擦，路上把手弄髒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: More tea, please, but not to the top.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɔr ti pliz bʌt nɑt tu ðə tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 再添點茶，但別倒到滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Halfway, so the cup stays warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæfˌweɪ soʊ ðə kʌp steɪz wɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 倒一半就好，杯子才不會太燙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this little cup too hot to hold?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs ˈlɪtəl kʌp tu hɑt tu hoʊld?/
dialogue.zh: 這個小杯子會不會太燙？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the thin rim cools very fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə θɪn rɪm kuls ˈvɛri fæst/
dialogue.zh: 不會，杯緣很薄，涼得很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this green tea from a local farm?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs ɡrin ti frʌm ə ˈloʊkəl fɑrm/
dialogue.zh: 這種綠茶是當地農場來的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it smells like a fresh leaf.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt smɛlz laɪk ə frɛʃ lif/
dialogue.zh: 是的，聞起來像新鮮的茶葉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the tea free with our meal?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ti fri wɪð ˈaʊər mil/
dialogue.zh: 茶水是跟餐點一起免費的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the pot is never on the bill.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə pɑt ɪz ˈnɛvɚ ɑn ðə bɪl/
dialogue.zh: 對，茶從不計在帳單上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is today's list of specials?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz təˈdeɪz lɪst ʌv ˈspɛʃəlz/
dialogue.zh: 今天的特製項目單在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the small board, behind the fish.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə smɔl bɔrd bɪˈhaɪnd ðə fɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 在那塊小黑板上，魚板後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh nice, I can read most of it.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ naɪs aɪ kæn rid moʊst ʌv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 哇真好，大部分我都看得懂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I wrote it fresh with a marker.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ roʊt ɪt frɛʃ wɪð ə ˈmɑrkɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我剛剛用麥克筆重新寫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My legs are tired from the long ride.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ lɛɡz ɑr ˈtaɪərd frʌm ðə lɔŋ raɪd/
dialogue.zh: 坐太久的車，我的腿好酸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest then, the belt never counts your time.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛst ðɛn ðə bɛlt ˈnɛvɚ kaʊnts jɔr taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 那就休息一下，回轉帶不會計你的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My friend could not come tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ frɛnd kʊd nɑt kʌm təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我朋友今晚來不了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shame, I saved a seat for him.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃeɪm aɪ seɪvd ə sit fɔr hɪm/
dialogue.zh: 真可惜，我還幫他留了位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I set the sauce dish here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ sɛt ðə sɔs dɪʃ hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 醬油碟放在這裡可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, right in front of the white napkin.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs raɪt ɪn frʌnt ʌv ðə waɪt ˈnæpkɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好，就擺在白色紙巾前面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is our first night out in weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈaʊər fɜrst naɪt aʊt ɪn wiks/
dialogue.zh: 這是我們好幾週來第一次出門吃飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let me make it a good one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛt mi meɪk ɪt ə ɡʊd wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 那我一定讓這一晚很好吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a hook here for my bag?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə hʊk hɪr fɔr maɪ bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 這邊有地方可以掛我的包包嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use this one, or keep it on your lap.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðɪs wʌn ɔr kip ɪt ɑn jɔr læp/
dialogue.zh: 用這個掛鉤，或抱在腿上也可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We cannot sit at the belt side, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈkænɑt sɪt æt ðə bɛlt saɪd raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我們沒辦法坐回轉帶那一側，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is full, but this end works well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz fʊl bʌt ðɪs ɛnd wɜrks wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 那一側坐滿了，不過這一端很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The belt has not started, are we early?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛlt hæz nɑt ˈstɑrtəd ɑr wi ˈɜrli/
dialogue.zh: 回轉帶還沒開始動，是我們早到了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six o'clock, it turns right on time.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks əˈklɑk ɪt tɜrnz raɪt ɑn taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 六點整就會轉，一向很準時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This seat feels cold, is the fan on?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs sit filz koʊld ɪz ðə fæn ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 這個位子冷冷的，是有開風嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can move you one seat in, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn muv ju wʌn sit ɪn ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那我幫你們往裡挪一個位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your little sushi bar looks so cozy.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈlɪtəl ˈsuʃi bɑr lʊks soʊ ˈkoʊzi/
dialogue.zh: 你們這間小壽司店看起來好溫馨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, we made it small on purpose.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju wi meɪd ɪt smɔl ɑn ˈpɜrpəs/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我們就是故意做這麼小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So many plates, where do I start?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈmɛni pleɪts wɛr du aɪ stɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 這麼多盤子，我該從哪裡開始？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow is fine, the belt keeps coming round.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ ɪz faɪn ðə bɛlt kips ˈkʌmɪŋ raʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來沒關係，盤子會一直繞過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I take one now, or wait a bit?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ teɪk wʌn naʊ ɔr weɪt ə bɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我現在就拿一盤，還是再等一下？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold on, the tuna is coming fresh.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɑn ðə ˈtunə ɪz ˈkʌmɪŋ frɛʃ/
dialogue.zh: 先別急，鮪魚那盤現做的馬上來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tuna is worth waiting for, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtunə ɪz wɜrθ ˈweɪtɪŋ fɔr raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 鮪魚值得等，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I made it ten minutes ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ meɪd ɪt tɛn ˈmɪnɪts əˈɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，我十分鐘前才剛做好的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May we have the wasabi on the side?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ wi hæv ðə wɑˈsɑbi ɑn ðə saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 山葵可以另外放在小碟上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, two small dishes, right away.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs tu smɔl ˈdɪʃɪz raɪt əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 當然，兩個小碟子，這就來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, and is the kitchen busy tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ænd ɪz ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn ˈbɪzi təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，今晚廚房忙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, my hands have not stopped since six.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs maɪ hændz hæv nɑt stɑpt sɪns sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 忙，從六點起我的手就沒停過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whoa, this cup is very hot right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /woʊ ðɪs kʌp ɪz ˈvɛri hɑt raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 哇，這個杯子現在非常燙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the tea is fresh, hold the base.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ti ɪz frɛʃ hoʊld ðə beɪs/
dialogue.zh: 對，茶是剛泡的，扶著杯底拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We eat sushi almost every Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi it ˈsuʃi ˈɔlmoʊst ˈɛvri ˈfraɪdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我們幾乎每個星期五都來吃壽司。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see your family most Fridays.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si jɔr ˈfæməli moʊst ˈfraɪdeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 大部分星期五我都看得到你們全家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight my wife picks the plates again.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈnaɪt maɪ waɪf pɪks ðə pleɪts əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 今晚又是我太太挑盤子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She has good eyes for fresh fish.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi hæz ɡʊd aɪz fɔr frɛʃ fɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 她挑新鮮魚的眼光很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and my girl copies every pick.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd maɪ ɡɜrl ˈkɑpiz ˈɛvri pɪk/
dialogue.zh: 對，我女兒也學她媽挑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two good eyes at one small counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ɡʊd aɪz ɑt wʌn smɔl ˈkaʊntɚ/
dialogue.zh: 小小的吧台邊有兩雙好眼光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more stool, my girl needs her own.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr stul maɪ ɡɜrl nidz hɜr oʊn/
dialogue.zh: 再麻煩一張凳子，我女兒要有自己那一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, nobody sat here since six.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈnoʊbədi sæt hɪr sɪns sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 沒人，從六點就空到現在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She can sit right beside us, thanks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi kæn sɪt raɪt bɪˈsaɪd ʌs θæŋks/
dialogue.zh: 她能坐在我們旁邊就好，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will place your bag under the counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl pleɪs jɔr bæɡ ˈʌndɚ ðə ˈkaʊntɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我幫你把包包放在吧台下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that is very kind of you.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæt ɪz ˈvɛri kaɪnd ʌv ju/
dialogue.zh: 哇，你真是太周到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We try to help before you ask.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi traɪ tu hɛlp bɪˈfɔr ju æsk/
dialogue.zh: 我們盡量在你開口前就處理好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the green tea made with real leaves?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ɡrin ti meɪd wɪð ril livz?/
dialogue.zh: 綠茶是用真的茶葉泡的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I brew it fresh every hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ bru ɪt frɛʃ ˈɛvri ˈaʊər/
dialogue.zh: 是的，我每小時重新泡一壺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, no bottled tea then.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs noʊ ˈbɑtəld ti ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那很好，不是瓶裝的茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the pot behind the cash register.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ðə pɑt bɪˈhaɪnd ðə kæʃ ˈrɛdʒɪstɚ/
dialogue.zh: 只有收銀台後面那一壺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I get the tea without ice?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd aɪ ɡɛt ðə ti wɪˈðaʊt aɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 我的茶可以不加冰塊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, the hot cup comes right up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs ðə hɑt kʌp kʌmz raɪt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，熱的這就來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does the tea stay warm?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ dʌz ðə ti steɪ wɔrm?/
dialogue.zh: 茶可以保溫多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About ten minutes, then it gets bitter.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt tɛn ˈmɪnɪts ðɛn ɪt ɡɛts ˈbɪtər/
dialogue.zh: 大約十分鐘，之後會變苦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I should drink it soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ ʃʊd drɪŋk ɪt sun/
dialogue.zh: 那我應該趕快喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slowly, it is fresh and very hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsloʊli ɪt ɪz frɛʃ ænd ˈvɛri hɑt/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢喝，它很新鮮也很燙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you also serve rice wine here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju ˈɔlsoʊ sɜrv raɪs waɪn hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡也有賣米酒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do, but only after six o'clock.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du bʌt ˈoʊnli ˈæftɚ sɪks əˈklɑk/
dialogue.zh: 有，不過要六點以後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the tea free for children too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ti fri fɔr ˈtʃɪldrən tu?/
dialogue.zh: 小朋友的茶也是免費的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, small cups cost nothing here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs smɔl kʌps kɔst ˈnʌθɪŋ hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 是的，小杯子在這裡不收錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, my daughter is six.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr θɪŋ maɪ ˈdɔtɚ ɪz sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 還有件事，我女兒六歲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then she can share your plate tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ʃi kæn ʃɛr jɔr pleɪt təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那她今晚跟您共用一個盤子就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we see the paper menu, please?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi si ðə ˈpeɪpɚ ˈmɛnju pliz/
dialogue.zh: 能給我們看看紙本菜單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here it is, the belt shows most of it.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪt ɪz ðə bɛlt ʃoʊz moʊst ʌv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，大部分菜色帶上都有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True, but the paper helps with names.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru bʌt ðə ˈpeɪpɚ hɛlps wɪð neɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 也是，不過紙上能對名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good point, the names are long today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd pɔɪnt ðə neɪmz ɑr lɔŋ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 說得對，這些名字今天特別長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some names are hard for me to read.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm neɪmz ɑr hɑrd fɔr mi tu rid/
dialogue.zh: 有些名字我實在讀不來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just point, and I will name it for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst pɔɪnt ænd aɪ wɪl neɪm ɪt fɔr ju/
dialogue.zh: 你用指的就好，我唸名字給你聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can the kids reach the belt from here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ðə kɪdz ritʃ ðə bɛlt frʌm hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 小朋友在這裡拿得到回轉帶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, or I will slide your stool in.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɔr aɪ wɪl slaɪd jɔr stul ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 可以，不然我把你的凳子往裡推一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Closer, please, she wants to watch the knife.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkloʊsɚ pliz ʃi wɑnts tu wɑtʃ ðə naɪf/
dialogue.zh: 往裡一點，她想看師傅下刀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good choice, my hands work fast there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tʃɔɪs maɪ hændz wɜrk fæst ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 選得好，我在那邊手很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am already hungry, just looking at it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ɔlˈrɛdi ˈhʌŋɡri dʒʌst ˈlʊkɪŋ æt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我光是看就已經餓了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Relax, the belt will bring you plenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈlæks ðə bɛlt wɪl brɪŋ ju ˈplɛnti/
dialogue.zh: 放輕鬆，回轉帶會一直送來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, a fresh pot, thank you kindly.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ə frɛʃ pɑt θæŋk ju ˈkaɪndli/
dialogue.zh: 哇，新泡的一壺，真是太感謝了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The pot is yours, I will keep it full.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɑt ɪz jɔrz aɪ wɪl kip ɪt fʊl/
dialogue.zh: 這壺是給你們的，我會幫你們續滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May we leave the pot on our tray?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ wi liv ðə pɑt ɑn ˈaʊər treɪ/
dialogue.zh: 茶壺可以留在我們的托盤上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it stays warm for ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt steɪz wɔrm fɔr tɛn ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 可以，它大約保溫十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I ask one thing before we eat?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ æsk wʌn θɪŋ bɪˈfɔr wi it/
dialogue.zh: 吃之前我能問一件事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A spoon for your son, coming now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə spun fɔr jɔr sʌn ˈkʌmɪŋ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 給你兒子的湯匙，這就來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at the plates, every color means a price.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt ði pleɪts ˈɛvri ˈkʌlɚ minz ə praɪs/
dialogue.zh: 你看這些盤子，每種顏色都代表一個價位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the color is the price, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðə ˈkʌlɚ ɪz ðə praɪs ˈɔlweɪz/
dialogue.zh: 對，顏色就是價位，永遠是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The white plate is two dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə waɪt pleɪt ɪz tu ˈdɑlɚz/
dialogue.zh: 白色的盤子是兩元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the black one is double that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə blæk wʌn ɪz ˈdʌbəl ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 那黑色的是它的兩倍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the blue plate more than the black one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə blu pleɪt mɔr ðæn ðə blæk wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 藍色的會比黑色的貴嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, blue is five and black is four.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs blu ɪz faɪv ænd blæk ɪz fɔr/
dialogue.zh: 是的，藍色五元，黑色四元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is that gold plate sitting alone?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz ðæt ɡoʊld pleɪt ˈsɪtɪŋ əˈloʊn/
dialogue.zh: 那個金色盤子為什麼獨自放在那裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is my special from today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz maɪ ˈspɛʃəl frʌm təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那是我今天特製的一道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I see the little card with prices?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ si ðə ˈlɪtəl kɑrd wɪð ˈpraɪsɪz/
dialogue.zh: 我能看那張小小的價格卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: White two, black four, and blue five.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪt tu blæk fɔr ænd blu faɪv/
dialogue.zh: 白色兩元，黑色四元，藍色五元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is the red plate then?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ðə rɛd pleɪt ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那紅色盤子多少錢呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is no red plate in this shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz noʊ rɛd pleɪt ɪn ðɪs ʃɑp/
dialogue.zh: 這家店沒有紅色的盤子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, so I have four colors to learn.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd soʊ aɪ hæv fɔr ˈkʌlɚz tu lɜrn/
dialogue.zh: 很好，那我要記的只有四種顏色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with white and black, they are enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑrt wɪð waɪt ænd blæk ðeɪ ɑr ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 先認白色和黑色就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which plate holds the tuna rolls?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ pleɪt hoʊldz ðə ˈtunə roʊlz/
dialogue.zh: 哪一種盤子裝鮪魚壽司卷？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuna sits on the plain white plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtunə sɪts ɑn ðə pleɪn waɪt pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 鮪魚都放在素白的盤子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And salmon comes on the blue one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ˈsælmən kʌmz ɑn ðə blu wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 那鮭魚就放在藍色盤子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, so blue means a richer fish.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt soʊ blu minz ə ˈrɪtʃɚ fɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 對，所以藍色代表油脂多的魚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the gold plates come out often?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðə ɡoʊld pleɪts kʌm aʊt ˈɔfən/
dialogue.zh: 金色盤子常常出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only at seven, I make twenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli æt ˈsɛvən aɪ meɪk ˈtwɛnti/
dialogue.zh: 只有七點那一次，我做二十盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, a blue plate with two shrimp.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ə blu pleɪt wɪð tu ʃrɪmp/
dialogue.zh: 看，一個藍色盤子上有兩尾蝦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it fast, the shrimp is best now.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ɪt fæst ðə ʃrɪmp ɪz bɛst naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 快拿，蝦子現在最新鮮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this white plate clean enough to use?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs waɪt pleɪt klin ɪˈnʌf tu juz/
dialogue.zh: 這個白盤子夠乾淨可以用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the stack behind you is fresh.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə stæk bɪˈhaɪnd ju ɪz frɛʃ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，你後面那一疊是剛洗好的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do these empty ones go anywhere?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðiz ˈɛmpti wʌnz ɡoʊ ˈɛniˌwɛr/
dialogue.zh: 這些空盤子要放到哪裡去？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drop them in the slot by your hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /drɑp ðɛm ɪn ðə slɑt baɪ jɔr hænd/
dialogue.zh: 順手丟進手邊那個洞口就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, they count them from that slot.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðeɪ kaʊnt ðɛm frʌm ðæt slɑt/
dialogue.zh: 喔，他們是從那個洞口清點數量的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, I see your whole stack.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli aɪ si jɔr hoʊl stæk/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，你那一疊我看得一清二楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I keep my plates on the table?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ kip maɪ pleɪts ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 我可以把盤子留在桌上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, a small pile is fine here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ə smɔl paɪl ɪz faɪn hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 當然，這裡堆一小疊沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How high can the pile go?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ haɪ kæn ðə paɪl ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那堆最高可以堆到多高？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it low, or it will fall over.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt loʊ ɔr ɪt wɪl fɔl ˈoʊvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 堆低一點，不然會倒下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One black plate came with a huge roll.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn blæk pleɪt keɪm wɪð ə hjus roʊl/
dialogue.zh: 有一個黑色盤子上面卷好大一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one feeds two people, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn fits tu ˈpipəl aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 那一盤我覺得夠兩個人吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This white plate has three pieces of eel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs waɪt pleɪt hæz θri ˈpisɪz ʌv il/
dialogue.zh: 我這盤白的有三塊鰻魚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, eel is sweet and very soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt il ɪz swit ænd ˈvɛri sɔft/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，鰻魚甜甜又很軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which color is the cheapest on the belt?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈkʌlɚ ɪz ðə ˈtʃipɪst ɑn ðə bɛlt/
dialogue.zh: 回轉帶上哪種顏色最便宜？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: White, always white, two dollars each.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪt ˈɔlweɪz waɪt tu ˈdɑlɚz itʃ/
dialogue.zh: 白色，永遠是白色，一盤兩元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So white is my best friend tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ waɪt ɪz maɪ bɛst frɛnd təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那白色就是我今晚的好朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And blue is for a special night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ənd blu ɪz fɔr ə ˈspɛʃəl naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 藍色嘛，就留給特別的日子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you see a green plate anywhere?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju si ə ɡrin pleɪt ˈɛniˌwɛr/
dialogue.zh: 你有看見綠色的盤子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, they stopped making those last year.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðeɪ stɑpt ˈmeɪkɪŋ ðoz læst jɪr/
dialogue.zh: 沒有，他們去年就不用那種了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, one plate is bright orange here.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk wʌn pleɪt ɪz braɪt ˈɔrɪndʒ hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 你看，這裡有一個亮橘色的盤子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a joke plate, do not eat it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə dʒok pleɪt du nɑt it ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那是搞笑的盤子，不要吃它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You made it for a child's smile.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju meɪd ɪt fɔr ə tʃaɪldz smaɪl/
dialogue.zh: 你做那個是要讓小朋友笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, and nobody charges for it.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru ænd ˈnoʊbədi ˈtʃɑrdʒɪz fɔr ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，那種盤子不收錢的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you hold this blue plate for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju hoʊld ðɪs blu pleɪt fɔr mi/
dialogue.zh: 能幫我拿一下這個藍盤子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, it is heavy with the roe.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪt ɪz ˈhɛvi wɪð ðə roʊ/
dialogue.zh: 給你，裝滿魚籽所以沉甸甸的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the fish raw on these dark plates?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə fɪʃ rɔ ɑn ðiz dɑrk pleɪts/
dialogue.zh: 這些深色盤子上的魚是生的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, all of them are raw tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɔl ʌv ðɛm ɑr rɔ təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 是的，今晚全部都沒煮熟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will try one raw piece.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl traɪ wʌn rɔ pis/
dialogue.zh: 那我來嚐一塊生的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with tuna, it is the mildest.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑrt wɪð ˈtunə ɪt ɪz ðə ˈmaɪldɪst/
dialogue.zh: 從鮪魚開始，那個味道最溫和。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which plate is the cooked shrimp on?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ pleɪt ɪz ðə kʊkt ʃrɪmp ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 煮熟的蝦子放在哪種盤子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cooked ones sit on plain white.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kʊkt wʌnz sɪt ɑn pleɪn waɪt/
dialogue.zh: 煮過的都是放在白色盤上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: White again, I am becoming an expert.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪt əˈɡɛn aɪ æm bɪˈkʌmɪŋ ən ˈɛkspɜrt/
dialogue.zh: 又是白色，我就要變成專家了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soon you will know every plate by heart.
dialogue.phonetic: /sun ju wɪl noʊ ˈɛvri pleɪt baɪ hɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 很快你就能把所有盤子背起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do people here eat many plates?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ˈpipəl hɪr it ˈmɛni pleɪts/
dialogue.zh: 這裡的人會吃很多盤嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most take ten, and that is normal.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst teɪk tɛn ænd ðæt ɪz ˈnɔrməl/
dialogue.zh: 大部分吃十盤，那樣很平常。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten white plates is only twenty dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn waɪt pleɪts ɪz ˈoʊnli ˈtwɛnti ˈdɑlɚz/
dialogue.zh: 十盤白色才二十元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, but nobody stops at ten here.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru bʌt ˈnoʊˌbɑdi stɑps æt tɛn hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，可是在這裡沒人只吃十盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I count my plates now: five white, two black.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kaʊnt maɪ pleɪts naʊ faɪv waɪt tu blæk/
dialogue.zh: 我現在數我的盤子：五盤白，兩盤黑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep one more black and you are full.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip wʌn mɔr blæk ænd ju ɑr fʊl/
dialogue.zh: 再拿一盤黑的，你就飽了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that black plate going around twice?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt blæk pleɪt ˈɡoʊɪŋ əˈraʊnd twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 那盤黑色的已經繞過兩圈了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the belt comes back every twenty minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə bɛlt kʌmz bæk ˈɛvri ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 是的，回轉帶每二十分鐘繞回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So if I miss it, I wait again.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ɪf aɪ mɪs ɪt aɪ weɪt əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 所以我錯過了就得再等一圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or ask me, I plate one fresh.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔr æsk mi aɪ pleɪt wʌn frɛʃ/
dialogue.zh: 或是跟我說，我現做一盤新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you see us from back there?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju si ʌs frʌm bæk ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 你在那邊看得到我們嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I watch the plates, not faces.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ wɑtʃ ðə pleɪts nɑt ˈfeɪsɪz/
dialogue.zh: 看得到，我盯的是盤子不是臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want the plate with the fat white rice.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt ðə pleɪt wɪð ðə fæt waɪt raɪs/
dialogue.zh: 我要那盤飯捏得飽飽的白色壽司。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one is vinegar rice, and it is good.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn ɪz ˈvɪnɪɡɚ raɪs ænd ɪt ɪz ɡʊd/
dialogue.zh: 那盤是醋飯，很好吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which plate should I never take?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ pleɪt ʃʊd aɪ ˈnɛvɚ teɪk/
dialogue.zh: 哪一種盤子我不該拿？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any plate that has sat too long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni pleɪt ðæt hæz sæt tu lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 任何在帶上放太久的盤子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How can I tell an old plate?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ kæn aɪ tɛl ən oʊld pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我要怎麼看出盤子放舊了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rice looks dry and the fish is dull.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə raɪs lʊks draɪ ænd ðə fɪʃ ɪz dʌl/
dialogue.zh: 飯看起來乾乾的，魚也沒光澤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good tip, I will watch the rice edges.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tɪp aɪ wɪl wɑtʃ ðə raɪs ˈɛdʒɪz/
dialogue.zh: 好建議，我會注意飯的邊緣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Also the sauce line fades on old ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ ðə sɔs laɪn feɪdz ɑn oʊld wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 還有醬汁那條線，放久就淡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these little plates for the ginger?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðiz ˈlɪtəl pleɪts fɔr ðə ˈdʒɪndʒɚ/
dialogue.zh: 這些小盤子是放薑的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, ginger sits in the small wooden box.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈdʒɪndʒɚ sɪts ɪn ðə smɔl ˈwʊdən bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 不是，薑是裝在小木盒裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That box is cuter than the plates.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt bɑks ɪz ˈkjutɚ ðæn ðə pleɪts/
dialogue.zh: 那個木盒比盤子還可愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can ask for a second box, free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn æsk fɔr ə ˈsɛkənd bɑks fri/
dialogue.zh: 你可以再要一個木盒，不收費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the plate with the most fish?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ðə pleɪt wɪð ðə moʊst fɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 魚堆得最高的那盤在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The black one near the wasabi jar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə blæk wʌn nɪr ðə wɑˈsɑbi dʒɑr/
dialogue.zh: 就在山葵罐旁邊那盤黑色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A jar, not a tiny dish?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə dʒɑr nɑt ə ˈtaɪni dɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 是一個罐子，不是小碟子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The jar keeps the paste fresh longer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dʒɑr kips ðə peɪst frɛʃ ˈlɔŋɡər/
dialogue.zh: 用罐子裝，泥狀山葵才能保鮮久一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I will learn one more color today.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪ wɪl lɜrn wʌn mɔr ˈkʌlɚ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好，那我今天再多認一種顏色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gold, the eight dollar plate at seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊld ðə eɪt ˈdɔlɚ pleɪt æt ˈsɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 金色，七點那盤八元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have now seen all five colors.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv naʊ sin ɔl faɪv ˈkʌlɚz/
dialogue.zh: 我現在五種顏色都看過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only four cost money, orange is a joke.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli fɔr kɔst ˈmʌni ˈɔrɪndʒ ɪz ə dʒok/
dialogue.zh: 只有四種要錢，橘色的是開玩笑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will ask for one tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl æsk fɔr wʌn təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那我今晚就開口要一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, I will wrap it for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪ wɪl ræp ɪt fɔr ju/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我會幫你包起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, my plate tower is the tall one.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk maɪ pleɪt ˈtaʊɚ ɪz ðə tɔl wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 你看，我那座盤子塔是最高的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yours has nine, and you are not done.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊrz hæz naɪn ænd ju ɑr nɑt dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 你那一疊九盤了，而且你還沒吃飽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the gold plate worth eight dollars?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ɡoʊld pleɪt wɜrθ eɪt ˈdɑlɚz/
dialogue.zh: 金色那盤值八元嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try one, then tell me what you think.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ wʌn ðɛn tɛl mi wʌt ju θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 嚐一盤，再告訴我你的想法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One gold plate, coming off the belt now.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ɡoʊld pleɪt ˈkʌmɪŋ ɔf ðə bɛlt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 一盤金色的，正從回轉帶下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, I made that one just now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛrfəl aɪ meɪd ðæt wʌn dʒʌst naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 小心，那盤是我剛做好的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Count with me: two, four, five, and eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt wɪð mi tu fɔr faɪv ænd eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 跟我一起數：二元、四元、五元、八元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: White, black, blue, gold, in that order.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪt blæk blu ɡoʊld ɪn ðæt ˈɔrdɚ/
dialogue.zh: 白、黑、藍、金，就是那個順序。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the colors are stuck in my head.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə ˈkʌlɚz ɑr stʌk ɪn maɪ hɛd/
dialogue.zh: 現在那些顏色都記在我腦裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, next time you will not ask me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd nɛkst taɪm ju wɪl nɑt æsk mi/
dialogue.zh: 很好，下次你就不會再問我了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I use my hands or a fork?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ juz maɪ hændz ɔr ə fɔrk/
dialogue.zh: 我該用手還是用叉子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hands are fine for the rice bites.
dialogue.phonetic: /hændz ɑr faɪn fɔr ðə raɪs baɪts/
dialogue.zh: 吃飯捏的那種，用手就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then where are my chopsticks?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wɛr ɑr maɪ ˈtʃɑpˌstɪks/
dialogue.zh: 那我的筷子在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They wait in the paper by your cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ weɪt ɪn ðə ˈpeɪpɚ baɪ jɔr kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 在你杯子旁邊的紙套裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One band holds them together here.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn bænd hoʊldz ðɛm təˈɡɛðɚ hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 這裡有一條紙帶把它們綁在一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slide the band off, then pull apart.
dialogue.phonetic: /slaɪd ðə bænd ɔf ðɛn pʊl əˈpɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 把紙帶推下來，然後往兩邊拉開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I break them up or down?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ breɪk ðɛm ʌp ɔr daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 我該往上掰還是往下掰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Side to side, like opening a small gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /saɪd tu saɪd laɪk ˈoʊpənɪŋ ə smɔl ɡeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 左右分開，像打開一扇小門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My fork came too, is that normal?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ fɔrk keɪm tu ɪz ðæt ˈnɔrməl/
dialogue.zh: 也給了我一把叉子，這很常見嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only for the salad bowl, never the rice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli fɔr ðə ˈsæləd boʊl ˈnɛvɚ ðə raɪs/
dialogue.zh: 只有海藻沙拉那道用叉子，飯糰不用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the fork stays on the side.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə fɔrk steɪz ɑn ðə saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 所以叉子就先放在旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, use it for the tiny melon.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs juz ɪt fɔr ðə ˈtaɪni ˈmɛlən/
dialogue.zh: 對，甜點的哈密瓜就用它吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I hold two sticks and a plate?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ hoʊld tu stɪks ænd ə pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我怎麼一手拿筷子一手端盤子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not hold the plate, it stays down.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt hoʊld ðə pleɪt ɪt steɪz daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 不要端盤子，讓它留在桌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I lift the small sauce dish?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ lɪft ðə smɔl sɔs dɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 我可以把小小的醬油碟拿起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, dip the fish, not the dish.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ dɪp ðə fɪʃ nɑt ðə dɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 不行，要蘸的是魚，不是碟子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this, fish down, rice up?
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ðɪs fɪʃ daʊn raɪs ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 像這樣，魚朝下，飯朝上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, the rice will fall apart otherwise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ðə raɪs wɪl fɔl əˈpɑrt ˈʌðɚˌwaɪz/
dialogue.zh: 完全正確，不然飯會散掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My pieces keep breaking on the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈpisɪz kip ˈbreɪkɪŋ ɑn ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我的壽司每次在半路就斷掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold it gently, like a tiny bird.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɪt ˈdʒɛntli laɪk ə ˈtaɪni bɜrd/
dialogue.zh: 輕一點夾，像捧著一隻小鳥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a funny way to say it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə ˈfʌni weɪ tu seɪ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你這個說法真好笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It works, your hand looks calmer now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɜrks jɔr hænd lʊks ˈkɑlmɚ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 有效吧，你的手現在穩多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it rude to point with a stick?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt rud tu pɔɪnt wɪð ə stɪk/
dialogue.zh: 用筷子指人會不會沒禮貌？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, never aim the fish at people.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈnɛvɚ eɪm ðə fɪʃ æt ˈpipəl/
dialogue.zh: 會，千萬別用筷子對著人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted, I will point with my eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtɪd aɪ wɪl pɔɪnt wɪð maɪ aɪz/
dialogue.zh: 我記住了，我用眼睛指就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know that look very well.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ ðæt lʊk ˈvɛri wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 那種眼神我最懂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pass a roll to my wife?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ pæs ə roʊl tu maɪ waɪf/
dialogue.zh: 我可以把壽司卷遞給我太太嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put it on her plate, never stick to stick.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ɪt ɑn hɜr pleɪt ˈnɛvɚ stɪk tu stɪk/
dialogue.zh: 夾到她盤子上，不要用筷子對傳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is stick to stick a no?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz stɪk tu stɪk ə noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼筷子對傳不行？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: People only do that at a funeral.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpipəl ˈoʊnli du ðæt æt ə ˈfjunɚəl/
dialogue.zh: 只有在喪禮上才會這樣做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I will use a clean plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪ wɪl juz ə klin pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好，那我就用一個乾淨的盤子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the kind way to share.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə kaɪnd weɪ tu ʃɛr/
dialogue.zh: 那樣分食才是體面的做法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I stand the sticks in my rice?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ stænd ðə stɪks ɪn maɪ raɪs/
dialogue.zh: 我可以把筷子直插在飯上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do not, that is very bad luck.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du nɑt ðæt ɪz ˈvɛri bæd lʌk/
dialogue.zh: 請不要，那樣非常不吉利。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, I am glad you told me.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ aɪ æm ɡlæd ju toʊld mi/
dialogue.zh: 哇，還好你有先跟我說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most guests do it at the first visit.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ɡɛsts du ɪt æt ðə fɜrst ˈvɪzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 大部分客人第一次都會想插。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How should I rest them when I stop?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ʃʊd aɪ rɛst ðɛm wɛn aɪ stɑp/
dialogue.zh: 我停下時筷子要放哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lay them flat across your little plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /leɪ ðɛm flæt əˈkrɔs jɔr ˈlɪtəl pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 平平地橫放在你的小盤上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Across, not hanging off the edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈkrɔs nɑt ˈhæŋɪŋ ɔf ði ɛdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 橫著放，不要懸在桌緣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, hanging looks like an arrow again.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ˈhæŋɪŋ lʊks laɪk ən ˈæroʊ əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 對，懸著看又像在瞄人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These sticks are rough, they snap fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz stɪks ɑr rʌf ðeɪ snæp fæst/
dialogue.zh: 這雙筷子好粗糙，很容易斷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wood ones always do, they are free.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd wʌnz ˈɔlweɪz du ðeɪ ɑr fri/
dialogue.zh: 木頭的都是這樣，反正不收錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free? Do I pay per pair?
dialogue.phonetic: /fri du aɪ peɪ pɚ pɛr/
dialogue.zh: 不收錢？筷子要按雙算嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the pair comes with your seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə pɛr kʌmz wɪð jɔr sit/
dialogue.zh: 不用，座位就附一雙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, mine already broke twice tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd maɪn ɔlˈrɛdi broʊk twaɪs təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 還好，我今晚已經斷過兩雙了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask for another pair, no shame here.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk fɔr əˈnʌðɚ pɛr noʊ ʃeɪm hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 再要一雙就好，這裡沒人笑你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two new sticks, please, and slowly this time.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu nu stɪks pliz ænd ˈsloʊli ðɪs taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 請給我新的兩支，這次我要慢一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take these, I rubbed the tips smooth.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðiz aɪ rʌbd ðə tɪps smuð/
dialogue.zh: 拿這雙，我把尖頭磨順了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You rubbed them? That is very kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju rʌbd ðɛm ðæt ɪz ˈvɛri kaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 你磨過它們了？真是太貼心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Splinters ruin a good sushi night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsplɪntɚz ruˈɪn ə ɡʊd ˈsuʃi naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 木刺會毀了一頓好壽司。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My daughter insists on using a fork.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈdɔtɚ ɪnˈsɪsts ɑn juzɪŋ ə fɔrk/
dialogue.zh: 我女兒堅持要用叉子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is fine for the rolled pieces.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz faɪn fɔr ðə roʊld ˈpisɪz/
dialogue.zh: 吃卷的那幾盤用叉子沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So a fork works for her rolls?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ə fɔrk wɜrks fɔr hɚ roʊlz/
dialogue.zh: 所以她吃那幾卷可以用叉子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and she can cut it in two.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ʃi kæn kʌt ɪt ɪn tu/
dialogue.zh: 可以，她還能把它切成兩半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She says the fish slips off every time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛz ðə fɪʃ slɪps ɔf ˈɛvri taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 她說魚片每次都會滑掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give her the rice balls, they hold tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv hɜr ðə raɪs bɔlz ðeɪ hoʊld taɪt/
dialogue.zh: 給她飯糰那一盤，那個夾得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do I do with the shell?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt du aɪ du wɪð ðə ʃɛl/
dialogue.zh: 那個貝殼我該怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the tiny fork for the clam meat.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə ˈtaɪni fɔrk fɔr ðə klæm mit/
dialogue.zh: 用小叉子把蛤蜊肉挑出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a fork for the clam?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə fɔrk fɔr ðə klæm/
dialogue.zh: 蛤蜊那道還有專門的叉子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One small fork for each shell dish.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn smɔl fɔrk fɔr itʃ ʃɛl dɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 每道貝類都附一支小叉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This place thinks about everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs pleɪs θɪŋks əˈbaʊt ˈɛvriθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 這間店什麼都想到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only about hands, trust me on that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli əˈbaʊt hændz trʌst mi ɑn ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 其實只想到手，你信我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands smell like fish now.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hændz smɛl laɪk fɪʃ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我的手現在聞起來都是魚腥味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bowl by the door is for that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə boʊl baɪ ðə dɔr ɪz fɔr ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 門口那盆水就是為這個準備的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm water for rinsing fingers?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm ˈwɔtɚ fɔr ˈrɪnsɪŋ ˈfɪŋɡɚz/
dialogue.zh: 溫水是用來洗手指的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, rinse twice and dry on the cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs rɪns twaɪs ænd draɪ ɑn ðə klɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 是的，沖兩次，再用布擦乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will wash before the last plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl wɑʃ bɪˈfɔr ðə læst pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我要在最後一盤之前先洗過手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, the ginger also cleans your mouth.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt ðə ˈdʒɪndʒɚ ˈɔlsoʊ klinz jɔr maʊθ/
dialogue.zh: 聰明，生薑也能清掉嘴裡的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I eat the ginger with the fish?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ it ðə ˈdʒɪndʒɚ wɪð ðə fɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 薑要跟魚一起吃嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, eat it between plates, not on top.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ it ɪt bɪˈtwin pleɪts nɑt ɑn tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 不用，兩盤之間吃，別放在魚上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So it rests the tongue between bites?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ɪt rɛsts ðə tʌŋ bɪˈtwin baɪts/
dialogue.zh: 所以它是讓舌頭在中間休息一下？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close enough, and it keeps you moving.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊs ɪˈnʌf ænd ɪt kips ju ˈmuvɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 差不多，這樣你就能一盤接一盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My son uses his fingers only.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ sɑn juzɪz hɪz ˈfɪŋɡɚz ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 我兒子只用手指拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let him, the rice is made for hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt hɪm ðə raɪs ɪz meɪd fɔr hændz/
dialogue.zh: 隨他，飯糰本來就是給手拿的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these rice bites made to hold?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðiz raɪs baɪts meɪd tu hoʊld/
dialogue.zh: 這些飯糰是捏得方便手拿的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, press lightly and they stay together.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs prɛs ˈlaɪtli ænd ðeɪ steɪ təˈɡɛðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 是的，輕輕壓就不會散。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I lick my thumb at the counter?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ lɪk maɪ θʌm æt ðə ˈkaʊntɚ/
dialogue.zh: 在吧台前我可以舔一下拇指嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cloth is there for that, my friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə klɔθ ɪz ðɛr fɔr ðæt maɪ frɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 旁邊那塊布就是拿來擦的，朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, wipe first, then take another plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt waɪp fɜrst ðɛn teɪk əˈnʌðɚ pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好，先擦手，再拿下一盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are learning faster than the belt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr ˈlɜrnɪŋ ˈfæstɚ ðæn ðə bɛlt/
dialogue.zh: 你學得比回轉帶還快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I hold the cone roll?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ hoʊld ðə kon roʊl/
dialogue.zh: 那個錐形的卷我怎麼拿？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like an ice cream cone, from below.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ən aɪs krim kon frʌm bɪˈloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 就像拿甜筒那樣，從下面托住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cone is the one with seaweed?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kon ɪz ðə wʌn wɪθ ˈsiˌwid/
dialogue.zh: 錐形那個是有海苔的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the crisp sheet wrapped around rice.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə krɪsp ʃit ræpt əˈraʊnd raɪs/
dialogue.zh: 是的，脆脆那片海苔包著飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a plate under the cone?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ə pleɪt ˈʌndɚ ðə kon/
dialogue.zh: 我需要在錐形卷下面墊個盤子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if the top is very full.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf ðə tɑp ɪz ˈvɛri fʊl/
dialogue.zh: 只在上面塞太滿的時候才需要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My seaweed sheet is falling apart.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈsiˌwid ʃit ɪz ˈfɔlɪŋ əˈpɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 我的海苔片已經開始碎了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eat from the wide end, not the tip.
dialogue.phonetic: /it frʌm ðə waɪd ɛnd nɑt ðə tɪp/
dialogue.zh: 從寬的那頭吃，別咬尖尖那一端。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: From the wide end, got it.
dialogue.phonetic: /frʌm ðə waɪd ɛnd ɡɑt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 從寬的那頭，我懂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow turns keep the roll in one piece.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ tɜrnz kip ðə roʊl ɪn wʌn pis/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢轉著吃，卷就不會散。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do people here really eat with hands?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ˈpipəl hɪr ˈrɪli it wɪð hændz/
dialogue.zh: 這裡的人真的都用手吃嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For rice bites, always, since my childhood.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr raɪs baɪts ˈɔlweɪz sɪns maɪ ˈtʃaɪldˌhʊd/
dialogue.zh: 拿飯糰那種，從小就一直這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That makes me feel less awkward.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt meɪks mi fil lɛs ˈɔkwɚd/
dialogue.zh: 那樣讓我沒那麼彆扭了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You were never awkward, only new here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wɜr ˈnɛvɚ ˈɔkwɚd ˈoʊnli nu hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 你一點都不彆扭，只是第一次來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more rule for the chopsticks, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr rul fɔr ðə ˈtʃɑpˌstɪks pliz/
dialogue.zh: 再問一條筷子的規矩好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not carry them like a sword.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt ˈkæri ðɛm laɪk ə sɔrd/
dialogue.zh: 不要像拿刀那樣握著走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not a sword, good, I felt that one.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ə sɔrd ɡʊd aɪ fɛlt ðæt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 不能像握刀，我剛剛真的有那樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest them down when you talk to us.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛst ðɛm daʊn wɛn ju tɔk tu ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 跟我們說話時就把筷子放下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So hands, sticks, and a little fork.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ hændz stɪks ænd ə ˈlɪtəl fɔrk/
dialogue.zh: 所以有手、筷子，還有一把小叉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three ways to enjoy one white plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri weɪz tu ɪnˈdʒɔɪ wʌn waɪt pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 三種方式，同一盤白盤壽司。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chef, can I ask you for one thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɛf kæn aɪ æsk ju fɔr wʌn θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 師傅，能麻煩你一件事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, tell me while I work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs tɛl mi waɪl aɪ wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 當然，你邊說我邊做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you add more wasabi on this?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ju æd mɔr wɑˈsɑbi ɑn ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 這盤可以多加一點山葵嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How much, a dot or a big spoon?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ə dɑt ɔr ə bɪɡ spun/
dialogue.zh: 要多少，一點點還是一大匙？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A big one, I love the hot green paste.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bɪɡ wʌn aɪ lʌv ðə hɑt ɡrin peɪst/
dialogue.zh: 要一大匙，我愛那種辣辣的綠泥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fresh root, I grate it right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /frɛʃ rut aɪ ɡreɪt ɪt raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 新鮮的山葵根，我現在就磨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You grate it here, not from a tube?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɡreɪt ɪt hɪr nɑt frʌm ə tjub/
dialogue.zh: 你在這裡現磨，不是從軟管擠出來的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tubes are fine, this root is better.
dialogue.phonetic: /tjubz ɑr faɪn ðɪs rut ɪz ˈbɛtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 軟管裝的也能用，不過這種根更好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It smells sharp already, my nose wakes up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt smɛlz ʃɑrp ɔlˈrɛdi maɪ noʊz weɪks ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 一聞就很嗆，我的鼻子都醒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the good sign, eat it soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə ɡʊd saɪn it ɪt sun/
dialogue.zh: 那就對了，快吃才好吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why does the heat go up my nose?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ dʌz ðə hit ɡoʊ ʌp maɪ noʊz/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼辣味會衝到鼻子上面？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Because the paste is fresh, not old.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈkɔz ðə peɪst ɪz frɛʃ nɑt oʊld/
dialogue.zh: 因為這泥是新鮮的，不是放久的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One piece for me, and one with none.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn pis fɔr mi ænd wʌn wɪθ nʌn/
dialogue.zh: 我要一塊加，一塊完全不加。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: None, one plain piece, coming right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /nʌn wʌn pleɪn pis ˈkʌmɪŋ raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題的，素的那塊馬上到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My son wants a tiny dot, not more.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ sɑn wɑnts ə ˈtaɪni dɑt nɑt mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 我兒子只要一點點，不要更多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will make it so mild he cannot tell.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl meɪk ɪt soʊ maɪld hi ˈkænɑt tɛl/
dialogue.zh: 我會調得很淡，讓他吃不出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you put the wasabi under the fish?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju pʊt ðə wɑˈsɑbi ˈʌndɚ ðə fɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 可以把山葵藏在魚片下面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is how I build every piece.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz haʊ aɪ bɪld ˈɛvri pis/
dialogue.zh: 我做每一塊都是這樣捏的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the rice hides it from my tongue.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə raɪs haɪdz ɪt frʌm maɪ tʌŋ/
dialogue.zh: 所以是飯把山葵隔開，讓舌頭先碰不到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press your tongue on it, then you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs jɔr tʌŋ ɑn ɪt ðɛn ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 用舌頭壓一下，你就知道了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too hot, my eyes are filling with tears.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu hɑt maɪ aɪz ɑr ˈfɪlɪŋ wɪð tɪrz/
dialogue.zh: 太辣了，我眼淚都要流出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tea helps, water will only spread it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ti hɛlps ˈwɔtɚ wɪl ˈoʊnli sprɛd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 喝茶有幫助，喝水只會讓辣味散開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Green tea really does cool the burn.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡrin ti ˈrɪli dʌz kul ðə bɜrn/
dialogue.zh: 綠茶真的能降那種燒燒的感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Milk works better, but we have none.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɪlk wɜrks ˈbɛtɚ bʌt wi hæv nʌn/
dialogue.zh: 牛奶更有效，不過我們沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then ginger is my fire truck tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈdʒɪndʒɚ ɪz maɪ ˈfaɪɚ trʌk təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那生薑就是我今晚的滅火車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It helps, and it clears the next taste.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hɛlps ænd ɪt klɪrz ðə nɛkst teɪst/
dialogue.zh: 有幫助，也能為下一道清味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you keep chili flakes at the counter?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju kip ˈtʃɪli fleɪks æt ðə ˈkaʊntɚ/
dialogue.zh: 吧台上有放辣椒粉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven spices in the red shaker, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən ˈspaɪsɪz ɪn ðə rɛd ˈʃeɪkɚ jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 有的，紅色小瓶裡是七味粉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I shake a little on my roll?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ ʃeɪk ə ˈlɪtəl ɑn maɪ roʊl/
dialogue.zh: 我可以在我的捲上撒一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two shakes, that is plenty for one plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ʃeɪks ðæt ɪz ˈplɛnti fɔr wʌn pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 搖兩下就好，一盤這樣量夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one already burns in a sweet way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn ɔlˈrɛdi bɜrnz ɪn ə swit weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這塊辣得甜甜的，很好吃的辣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eel sauce and spice, my house rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /il sɔs ænd spaɪs maɪ haʊs rul/
dialogue.zh: 鰻魚醬加香料，這是我的做法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chef, would you add a little more sauce?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɛf wʊd ju æd ə ˈlɪtəl mɔr sɔs/
dialogue.zh: 師傅，可以在上面多刷一點醬嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sweet or salty? I can do both.
dialogue.phonetic: /swit ɔr ˈsɔlti aɪ kæn du boʊθ/
dialogue.zh: 甜的還是鹹的？兩種我都能刷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both, and brush it on for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ænd brʌʃ ɪt ɑn fɔr mi/
dialogue.zh: 兩種都要，麻煩你幫我刷上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I brush the top, so your rice stays firm.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ brʌʃ ðə tɑp soʊ jɔr raɪs steɪz fɜrm/
dialogue.zh: 我只刷頂層，你的飯才會保持形狀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No sauce in my soy dish, thanks.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ sɔs ɪn maɪ sɔɪ dɪʃ θæŋks/
dialogue.zh: 我的醬油碟裡不要預先加醬，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just soy, cold and plain, coming now.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst sɔɪ koʊld ænd pleɪn ˈkʌmɪŋ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 就只有醬油，冷冷素素的，這就來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you mix wasabi into the soy here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju mɪks wɑˈsɑbi ˈɪntu ðə sɔɪ hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 你們會在這裡把山葵調進醬油嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some do, I pretend not to see.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm du aɪ priˈtɛnd nɑt tu si/
dialogue.zh: 有人會調，我就假裝沒看見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will mix it quietly today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl mɪks ɪt ˈkwaɪətli təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那我今天就悄悄調一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quietly is fine, loudly is a problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪətli ɪz faɪn ˈlaʊdli ɪz ə ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 小聲調沒問題，高聲就不好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How hot is the roll called fire?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ hɑt ɪz ðə roʊl kɔld faɪr/
dialogue.zh: 那個叫火的捲到底有多辣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three peppers, so ask before you bite.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈpɛpɚz soʊ æsk bɪˈfɔr ju baɪt/
dialogue.zh: 放了三種辣椒，咬之前要先問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask first, good, I learned that already.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk fɜrst ɡʊd aɪ lɜrnd ðæt ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 先問再吃，好，這個我已經學會了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people learn it with one bite.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ˈpipəl lɜrn ɪt wɪð wʌn baɪt/
dialogue.zh: 大部分人是一口就學會的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I trade this for a mild piece?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ treɪd ðɪs fɔr ə maɪld pis/
dialogue.zh: 這塊我可以換成不辣的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, here is tuna with no paste.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr hɪr ɪz ˈtunə wɪθ noʊ peɪst/
dialogue.zh: 可以，這塊鮪魚完全沒抹辣泥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the green roll also this spicy?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ɡrin roʊl ˈɔlsoʊ ðɪs ˈspaɪsi/
dialogue.zh: 綠色那捲也這麼辣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No spice there, only the avocado cream.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ spaɪs ðɛr ˈoʊnli ðə ˌævəˈkɑdoʊ krim/
dialogue.zh: 那捲不辣，只有酪梨醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chef, my wasabi is on the wrong piece.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɛf maɪ wɑˈsɑbi ɪz ɑn ðə rɔŋ pis/
dialogue.zh: 師傅，我的山葵跑到錯的那塊上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Swap it now, I will not say anything.
dialogue.phonetic: /swɑp ɪt naʊ aɪ wɪl nɑt seɪ ˈɛniθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 現在換過來就好，我不會亂講。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are too kind, I owe you one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr tu kaɪnd aɪ oʊ ju wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 你太客氣了，我欠你一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You owe the belt, it brought you here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju oʊ ðə bɛlt ɪt brɔt ju hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 你要謝的是回轉帶，是它把你帶來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, more heat on the eel.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr θɪŋ mɔr hit ɑn ði il/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，鰻魚那盤再加辣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: More heat on the eel, one second.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɔr hit ɑn ði il wʌn ˈsɛkənd/
dialogue.zh: 鰻魚加辣，請等我一秒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half of that wasabi, please, my friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ʌv ðæt wɑˈsɑbi pliz maɪ frɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 那團山葵只要一半就好，朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half? I gave the whole jar to you.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf aɪ ɡeɪv ðə hoʊl dʒɑr tu ju/
dialogue.zh: 一半？我剛剛把整罐都給你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No no, that is way too much green.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ noʊ ðæt ɪz weɪ tu mʌtʃ ɡrin/
dialogue.zh: 不不不，那個綠色實在太多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take two pieces, the rest goes back.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk tu ˈpisɪz ðə rɛst ɡoʊz bæk/
dialogue.zh: 你先吃兩塊，剩下的我收回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it rude to move food back?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt rud tu muv fʊd bæk/
dialogue.zh: 把食物推回去會不會沒禮貌？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not at a counter like ours, relax.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt æt ə ˈkaʊntɚ laɪk ˈaʊərz rɪˈlæks/
dialogue.zh: 在我們這種吧台不會，放輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I can send the eel back to you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ kæn sɛnd ði il bæk tu ju/
dialogue.zh: 那我可以把鰻魚那盤退回給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do, I will fix the heat level.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du aɪ wɪl fɪks ðə hit ˈlɛvəl/
dialogue.zh: 請這樣做，我幫你調整辣度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fix it mild, my tongue is on strike.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪks ɪt maɪld maɪ tʌŋ ɪz ɑn straɪk/
dialogue.zh: 調淡一點，我的舌頭已經罷工了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Strike, then rest, the ginger is right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /straɪk ðɛn rɛst ðə ˈdʒɪndʒɚ ɪz raɪt ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 罷工了就休息，薑就在那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do kids here get their own small wasabi?
dialogue.phonetic: /du kɪdz hɪr ɡɛt ðɛr oʊn smɔl wɑˈsɑbi/
dialogue.zh: 這裡的小朋友也有自己的小山葵嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They get a pea sized dot at most.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɡɛt ə ˈpi saɪzd dɑt æt moʊst/
dialogue.zh: 最多給一顆豌豆那麼大的量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That dot is perfect for my son.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt dɑt ɪz ˈpɜrfɪkt fɔr maɪ sɑn/
dialogue.zh: 那一點點對我兒子剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He can add more at the next plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi kæn æd mɔr æt ðə nɛkst pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 下一盤他再自己多加。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why do you make them so small here?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ du ju meɪk ðɛm soʊ smɔl hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 你們為什麼把每塊做得這麼小？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small pieces keep the fish taste clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl ˈpisɪz kip ðə fɪʃ teɪst klɪr/
dialogue.zh: 塊小，魚的味道才清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you make mine a little bigger?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju meɪk maɪn ə ˈlɪtəl ˈbɪɡɚ/
dialogue.zh: 可以把我的那塊捏大一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, two bites, the plate price stays the same.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr tu baɪts ðə pleɪt praɪs steɪz ðə seɪm/
dialogue.zh: 可以，變成兩口的份量，價格不變。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bigger piece, same price, that is fair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɪɡɚ pis seɪm praɪs ðæt ɪz fɛr/
dialogue.zh: 塊比較大，價格一樣，這樣很公道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We care more about the wasabi root.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kɛr mɔr əˈbaʊt ðə wɑˈsɑbi rut/
dialogue.zh: 我們更在乎的是山葵那塊根。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does that root come from, anyway?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dʌz ðæt rut kʌm frʌm ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 話說那個根是哪裡種的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A mountain farm two hours from here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈmaʊntən fɑrm tu ˈaʊərz frʌm hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 在山上的農場，離這裡兩小時車程。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two hours, and I eat it in one bite.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈaʊərz ænd aɪ it ɪt ɪn wʌn baɪt/
dialogue.zh: 開了兩小時的車，我一口就吃掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow, my friend, the taste needs air.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ maɪ frɛnd ðə teɪst nidz ɛr/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢吃，味道需要空氣才會打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it tastes like fresh grass, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪt teɪsts laɪk frɛʃ ɡræs ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，現在它吃起來像青草。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, old paste only tastes like pain.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs oʊld peɪst ˈoʊnli teɪsts laɪk peɪn/
dialogue.zh: 對，放久的泥只會辣到痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pain, but the good kind of pain.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪn bʌt ðə ɡʊd kaɪnd ʌv peɪn/
dialogue.zh: 痛，但是那種舒服的痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are a real fan of the heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr ə ril fæn ʌv ðə hit/
dialogue.zh: 你還真是辣味的忠實粉絲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and I will take one more plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd aɪ wɪl teɪk wʌn mɔr pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，所以我要再拿一盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The spicy tuna is leaving the kitchen now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈspaɪsi ˈtunə ɪz ˈlivɪŋ ðə ˈkɪtʃən naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 辣拌鮪魚那盤正從廚房出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell me when it passes my hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl mi wɛn ɪt ˈpæsɪz maɪ hænd/
dialogue.zh: 它經過我手邊時跟我說一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any second now, hold your chopsticks up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni ˈsɛkənd naʊ hoʊld jɔr ˈtʃɑpˌstɪks ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 這就要到了，把筷子舉高一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There it is, and I smell the chili.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪt ɪz ænd aɪ smɛl ðə ˈtʃɪli/
dialogue.zh: 來了，我聞到辣椒的香氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eat it with the tea, not the wine.
dialogue.phonetic: /it ɪt wɪð ðə ti nɑt ðə waɪn/
dialogue.zh: 配茶吃，別配酒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good call, the wine makes the burn worse.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kɔl ðə waɪn meɪks ðə bɜrn wɜrs/
dialogue.zh: 說得對，酒會讓灼燙感更糟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Worse and louder, that is what happens.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɜrs ænd ˈlaʊdər ðæt ɪz wʌt ˈhæpənz/
dialogue.zh: 更糟還會一直咳嗽，就是那樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My nose is running, is that normal?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ noʊz ɪz ˈrʌnɪŋ ɪz ðæt ˈnɔrməl/
dialogue.zh: 我鼻涕流出來了，這正常嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very normal, grab a paper from the stack.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛri ˈnɔrməl ɡræb ə ˈpeɪpɚ frʌm ðə stæk/
dialogue.zh: 很正常，從那一疊抽張紙巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more question, can you skip the salt?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr ˈkwɛstʃən kæn ju skɪp ðə sɔlt/
dialogue.zh: 再問一件事，可以不撒鹽嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No salt on the roe, done, no problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ sɔlt ɑn ðə roʊ dʌn noʊ ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 魚籽那盤不撒鹽，已經處理好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You say that while smiling at me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju seɪ ðæt waɪl ˈsmaɪlɪŋ æt mi/
dialogue.zh: 你一邊笑著對我說這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smiling is part of the extra heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsmaɪlɪŋ ɪz pɑrt ʌv ðə ˈɛkstrə hit/
dialogue.zh: 微笑也是我加的額外辣度的一部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks chef, my tongue will remember this.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks ʃɛf maɪ tʌŋ wɪl rɪˈmɛmbɚ ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝師傅，我的舌頭會記得這頓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come back tomorrow, I will grate more.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm bæk təˈmɑroʊ aɪ wɪl ɡreɪt mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 明天再來，我會多磨一些山葵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, does this one have egg inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt dʌz ðɪs wʌn hæv ɛɡ ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 等一下，這一盤裡面有蛋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the yellow roll is egg, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈjɛloʊ roʊl ɪz ɛɡ ˈɔlweɪz/
dialogue.zh: 是的，黃色那捲一定是蛋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My girl eats no egg at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ɡɜrl its noʊ ɛɡ ɑt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 我女兒完全不吃蛋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then skip the yellow roll on the belt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn skɪp ðə ˈjɛloʊ roʊl ɑn ðə bɛlt/
dialogue.zh: 那就跳過回轉帶上的黃色那捲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which rolls are free of egg?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ roʊlz ɑr fri ʌv ɛɡ/
dialogue.zh: 哪幾卷是完全沒有蛋的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuna, salmon, cucumber, all without egg.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtunə ˈsælmən ˈkjumˌbɚ ɔl wɪˈðaʊt ɛɡ/
dialogue.zh: 鮪魚、鮭魚、小黃瓜，那些都沒蛋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the white sauce made with egg?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə waɪt sɔs meɪd wɪð ɛɡ/
dialogue.zh: 白色的醬汁是用蛋做的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The creamy one uses egg, yes it does.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkrimi wʌn ˈjuzɪz ɛɡ jɛs ɪt dʌz/
dialogue.zh: 那種奶油醬確實有蛋，沒錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then give me the plain roll, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɡiv mi ðə pleɪn roʊl pliz/
dialogue.zh: 那請給我沒有醬的那一卷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plain means fish and rice, nothing more.
dialogue.phonetic: /pleɪn minz fɪʃ ænd raɪs ˈnʌθɪŋ mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 素卷就是魚加飯，沒有別的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the fish eggs on top?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə fɪʃ ɛɡz ɑn tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 那上面那些魚蛋呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roe is not chicken egg, but it is fish.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊ ɪz nɑt ˈtʃɪkən ɛɡ bʌt ɪt ɪz fɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 魚籽不是雞蛋，但它還是魚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My son gets sick from fish, not eggs.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ sɑn ɡɛts sɪk frʌm fɪʃ nɑt ɛɡz/
dialogue.zh: 我兒子是對魚過敏，不是對蛋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then keep him on the egg roll only.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn kip hɪm ɑn ði ɛɡ roʊl ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 那就只讓他吃蛋那捲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the shrimp roll touch the crab?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ʃrɪmp roʊl tʌtʃ ðə kræb/
dialogue.zh: 蝦子那捲會不會碰到螃蟹？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same knife, same board, both are shellfish.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm naɪf seɪm bɔrd boʊθ ɑr ˈʃɛlˌfɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 同一把刀、同一塊板，兩樣都碰過貝類。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That matters, he breaks out in spots.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈmætɚz hi breɪks aʊt ɪn spɑts/
dialogue.zh: 這很重要，他一碰就長紅疹。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will wash my hands and the board.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl wɑʃ maɪ hændz ænd ðə bɔrd/
dialogue.zh: 我會重新洗手，還有刀板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also, does the soy sauce have wheat?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ dʌz ðə sɔɪ sɔs hæv wit/
dialogue.zh: 還有，醬油裡含有小麥嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually yes, the brown sauce has wheat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuʒəwəli jɛs ðə braʊn sɔs hæz wit/
dialogue.zh: 通常有，褐色那款含有小麥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I need the bottle without wheat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ nid ðə ˈbɑtəl wɪˈðaʊt wit/
dialogue.zh: 那我需要不含小麥的那瓶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The green cap bottle, it sits by you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡrin kæp ˈbɑtəl ɪt sɪts baɪ ju/
dialogue.zh: 綠蓋那一瓶，它就在你旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there sesame in the brown top?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ˈsɛsəmi ɪn ðə braʊn tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 褐色那捲上面的醬有芝麻嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two seeds on each piece, small ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tu siz ɑn itʃ pis smɔl wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 有，每塊撒兩粒，很小的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My boy cannot have any sesame.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bɔɪ ˈkænɑt hæv ˈɛni ˈsɛsəmi/
dialogue.zh: 我兒子一點芝麻都不能吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can brush the seeds off with a spoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn brʌʃ ðə siz ɔf wɪð ə spun/
dialogue.zh: 我可以用湯匙把芝麻刷掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would that be safe for him to eat?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ðæt bi seɪf fɔr hɪm tu it/
dialogue.zh: 那樣他就能安全吃了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For seeds, yes, but tell me first.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr siz jɛs bʌt tɛl mi fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 芝麻可以，但你要先跟我說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell you first, that is the plan today.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl ju fɜrst ðæt ɪz ðə plæn təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 先跟你說，這就是今天的計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I write the notes on my board.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪ raɪt ðə noʊts ɑn maɪ bɔrd/
dialogue.zh: 好，我會把備註寫在板上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the ginger slices soaked in anything?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə ˈdʒɪndʒɚ ˈsaɪlsɪz soʊkt ɪn ˈɛniθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 薑片是泡過什麼東西的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sugar and vinegar, that is the whole list.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃʊɡɚ ænd ˈvɪnɪɡɚ ðæt ɪz ðə hoʊl lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 糖和醋，成分就這兩樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No color in them, that is good news.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈkʌlɚ ɪn ðɛm ðæt ɪz ɡʊd nuz/
dialogue.zh: 它們沒有色素，這真是好消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The pink kind does have color, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɪŋk kaɪnd dʌz hæv ˈkʌlɚ ˈsɑri/
dialogue.zh: 粉紅色那種是有色素的，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We will take the pale ones from now on.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɪl teɪk ðə peɪl wʌnz frʌm naʊ ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 我們以後都要淡色那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will keep a small box for you two.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kip ə smɔl bɑks fɔr ju tu/
dialogue.zh: 我會幫你們兩位留一小盒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the fish here cooked twice or once?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə fɪʃ hɪr kʊkt twaɪs ɔr wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 這裡的魚是煮兩次還是一次？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We fire it once, the rest stays raw.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈfaɪr ɪt wʌns ðə rɛst steɪz rɔ/
dialogue.zh: 我們用火烤一下，其他都是生的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fire on the fish? That smells so good.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪr ɑn ðə fɪʃ ðæt smɛlz soʊ ɡʊd/
dialogue.zh: 用火烤魚？那個味道好香。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It melts the fat, try one right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt mɛlts ðə fæt traɪ wʌn raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 脂肪會化開，現在就嚐一塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you make mine with no raw part?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju meɪk maɪn wɪθ noʊ rɔ pɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 可以把我那份全做熟嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can cook the fish through for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn kʊk ðə fɪʃ θru fɔr ju/
dialogue.zh: 我可以把魚整個煮熟給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please, my wife is carrying a baby.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz maɪ waɪf ɪz ˈkæriɪŋ ə ˈbeɪbi/
dialogue.zh: 麻煩了，我太太懷孕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then everything cooked, that is smart.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈɛvriθɪŋ kʊkt ðæt ɪz smɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 那全部都要煮熟，這樣才聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing raw for her, only the cooked part.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ rɔ fɔr hɜr ˈoʊnli ðə kʊkt pɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 給她的一切都別生的，只要熟的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cooked shrimp and egg, both are safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊkt ʃrɪmp ænd ɛɡ boʊθ ɑr seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 熟蝦和蛋卷，兩樣都很安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Safe is what I want on this plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪf ɪz wʌt aɪ wɑnt ɑn ðɪs pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我這個盤子上只要安全的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I will send you two of those.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl sɛnd ju tu ʌv ðoz/
dialogue.zh: 那我送兩盤那樣的給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the cream roll have any dairy?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə krim roʊl hæv ˈɛni ˈdɛri/
dialogue.zh: 奶油那捲含有奶製品嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, milk cream inside, a little cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs mɪlk krim ɪnˈsaɪd ə ˈlɪtəl kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 有，裡面是牛奶奶油，一小杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My boy drinks milk, so that is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bɔɪ drɪŋks mɪlk soʊ ðæt ɪz faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 我兒子喝牛奶，所以那個沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, then he can have the sweet roll.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðɛn hi kæn hæv ðə swit roʊl/
dialogue.zh: 好，那他可以點那捲甜的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are there peanuts in anything here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðɛr ˈpinʌts ɪn ˈɛniθɪŋ hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 這裡有任何東西含有花生嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No peanuts in the kitchen, never any.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈpinʌts ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃən ˈnɛvɚ ˈɛni/
dialogue.zh: 廚房裡完全沒有花生，從不進。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a big relief for our family.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə bɪɡ rɪˈlif fɔr ˈaʊər ˈfæməli/
dialogue.zh: 這對我們全家來說是很大的解脫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We keep nuts off every counter here.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kip nʌts ɔf ˈɛvri ˈkaʊntɚ hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 我們這裡每個吧台都不準有堅果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the dust from the flour, is that here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə dʌst frʌm ðə ˈflaʊɚ ɪz ðæt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 那麵粉的粉塵也在這裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only at the back, where we fry tempura.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli æt ðə bæk wɛr wi fraɪ tɛmˈpurə/
dialogue.zh: 只在後面，我們在那裡裹粉油炸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, she must stay far from flour.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ʃi mʌst steɪ fɑr frʌm ˈflaʊɚ/
dialogue.zh: 很好，她要離麵粉遠一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your seat is far, I counted the steps.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr sit ɪz fɑr aɪ ˈkaʊntɪd ðə stɛps/
dialogue.zh: 你的座位很遠，我數過階梯了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You counted the steps to my seat?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈkaʊntɪd ðə stɛps tu maɪ sit/
dialogue.zh: 你連到我座位有幾步都數過？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve steps, that is safe for flour.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv stɛps ðæt ɪz seɪf fɔr ˈflaʊɚ/
dialogue.zh: 十二步，那個距離對麵粉很安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You moved my seat on purpose today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju muvd maɪ sit ɑn ˈpɜrpəs təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 你今天特地幫我換了座位？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I did, your note said no flour dust.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɪd jɔr noʊt sɛd noʊ ˈflaʊɚ dʌst/
dialogue.zh: 是的，你的備註寫著不要麵粉塵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Notes travel fast in this little bar.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊts ˈtrævəl fæst ɪn ðɪs ˈlɪtəl bɑr/
dialogue.zh: 備註在這間小店傳得好快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They must, the kitchen reads them twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ mʌst ðə ˈkɪtʃən ridz ðɛm twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 一定要這樣，廚房會看兩遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I ask about the green paste again?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ æsk əˈbaʊt ðə ɡrin peɪst əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 我能再問一下那個綠色的泥嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Root, starch, water, that is the list.
dialogue.phonetic: /rut stɑrtʃ ˈwɔtɚ ðæt ɪz ðə lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 根莖、澱粉、水，成分就這些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No egg, no milk, so I can eat it.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɛɡ noʊ mɪlk soʊ aɪ kæn it ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 沒有蛋也沒有奶，那我就能吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can, and it helps the fish taste.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn ænd ɪt hɛlps ðə fɪʃ teɪst/
dialogue.zh: 你可以吃，它還會幫魚提味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is in the pink sweet roll then?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ɪn ðə pɪŋk swit roʊl ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那粉紅色的甜捲裡面是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Berry jam and cream, and a little egg.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛri dʒæm ænd krim ænd ə ˈlɪtəl ɛɡ/
dialogue.zh: 莓果醬、奶油，還有一點蛋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half egg would be fine for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ɛɡ wʊd bi faɪn fɔr mi/
dialogue.zh: 半份蛋我就可以吃了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can plate half, is that enough?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn pleɪt hæf ɪz ðæt ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 我可以只放一半蛋，夠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is perfect, you think like a cook.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ˈpɜrfɪkt ju θɪŋk laɪk ə kʊk/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，你的想法像個廚師。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I only cook, you are the careful father.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈoʊnli kʊk ju ɑr ðə ˈkɛrfəl ˈfɑðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我只有煮飯，你才是那個小心的爸爸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I trust this whole cucumber plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ aɪ trʌst ðɪs hoʊl ˈkjumˌbɚ pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 現在我完全信任這盤小黃瓜了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trust the plate, I wrote your name on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /trʌst ðə pleɪt aɪ roʊt jɔr neɪm ɑn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 放心吃吧，我在盤邊寫了你的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You wrote my name on a plate?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju roʊt maɪ neɪm ɑn ə pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你在盤子上寫了我的名字？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small tag, so the kitchen knows you.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl tæɡ soʊ ðə ˈkɪtʃən noʊz ju/
dialogue.zh: 一個小標籤，讓廚房認得你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A tag on the plate, brand new to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə tæɡ ɑn ðə pleɪt brænd nu tu mi/
dialogue.zh: 盤子上有標籤，這我是第一次看到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We started it for the safe notes.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈstɑrtɪd ɪt fɔr ðə seɪf noʊts/
dialogue.zh: 我們是為了安全的備註才開始用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which fish is safe for a small child?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ fɪʃ ɪz seɪf fɔr ə smɔl tʃaɪld/
dialogue.zh: 哪種魚對小小孩是安全的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cooked shrimp, soft fish, no sharp bones.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊkt ʃrɪmp sɔft fɪʃ noʊ ʃɑrp boʊnz/
dialogue.zh: 熟的蝦、軟身的魚，沒有尖刺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No bones, good, that scares us both.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ boʊnz ɡʊd ðæt skɛrz ʌs boʊθ/
dialogue.zh: 沒有骨頭，那真的嚇到我們兩個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I pull every bone out, twice, I promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ pʊl ˈɛvri boʊn aʊt twaɪs aɪ ˈprɑmɪs/
dialogue.zh: 我會把骨頭都拔掉，拔兩遍，我保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You promise with your knife in hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈprɑmɪs wɪð jɔr naɪf ɪn hænd/
dialogue.zh: 你一邊手握菜刀一邊這樣保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the strongest promise here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə ˈstrɔŋɡɪst ˈprɑmɪs hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡那就是最有力的保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those allergy tags really save us time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðoʊz ˈælɜrdʒi tæɡz ˈrɪli seɪv ʌs taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 那些過敏標籤真的幫我省時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten seconds to read, then we cook.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈsɛkəndz tu rid ðɛn wi kʊk/
dialogue.zh: 讀起來十秒，然後我就開工。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last check, does the eel sauce hold egg?
dialogue.phonetic: /læst tʃɛk dʌz ði il sɔs hoʊld ɛɡ/
dialogue.zh: 最後確認，鰻魚醬裡有蛋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soy, sugar, eel stock, no egg at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔɪ ˈʃʊɡɚ il stɑk noʊ ɛɡ ɑt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 醬油、糖、鰻魚高湯，完全沒蛋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then two eel plates for our table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tu il pleɪts fɔr ˈaʊər ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 那我們要兩盤鰻魚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two eel, one with spice, one plain.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu il wʌn wɪð spaɪs wʌn pleɪn/
dialogue.zh: 兩盤鰻魚，一盤加辣，一盤原味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do you remember all these needs?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du ju rɪˈmɛmbɚ ɔl ðiz nidz/
dialogue.zh: 你怎麼記得住這麼多要求？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
