dialogue.text: The plates tell me, white means simple.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pleɪts tɛl mi waɪt minz ˈsɪmpəl/
dialogue.zh: 盤子會告訴我，白色就是單純的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Simple is my word today, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪmpəl ɪz maɪ wɜrd təˈdeɪ θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 今天我就只要單純的，謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Simple food, safe hands, that is us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪmpəl fʊd seɪf hændz ðæt ɪz ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 單純的餐點、安全的手，我們就是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I can eat without asking twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ aɪ kæn it wɪˈðaʊt ˈæskɪŋ twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 現在我可以放心吃，不用一直問。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask me always, that is my job here.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk mi ˈɔlweɪz ðæt ɪz maɪ dʒɑb hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 你隨時都可以問，這就是我的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I think we are ready to count now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk wi ɑr ˈrɛdi tu kaʊnt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我想我們現在可以數盤子了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, let me see your plate stack.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr lɛt mi si jɔr pleɪt stæk/
dialogue.zh: 好，讓我看看你們那一疊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine white, four black, two blue.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn waɪt fɔr blæk tu blu/
dialogue.zh: 白色九盤，黑色四盤，藍色兩盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And one gold on the top, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd wʌn ɡoʊld ɑn ðə tɑp raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 最上面還有一盤金色的，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the gold one from seven o'clock.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ɡoʊld wʌn frʌm ˈsɛvən əˈklɑk/
dialogue.zh: 對，那是七點那盤金色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I write it on this small slip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ raɪt ɪt ɑn ðɪs smɔl slɪp/
dialogue.zh: 那我把它寫在這張小單上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that slip how you count here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt slɪp haʊ ju kaʊnt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 你們就是靠這張單子算的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One line per color, then the total.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn laɪn pɜr ˈkʌlɚ ðɛn ðə ˈtoʊtəl/
dialogue.zh: 每種顏色寫一行，最後加總。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two, four, five, eight, you write it all.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu fɔr faɪv eɪt ju raɪt ɪt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 二元、四元、五元、八元，你都寫上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, white two, black four, blue five.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs waɪt tu blæk fɔr blu faɪv/
dialogue.zh: 對，白兩元、黑四元、藍五元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine whites, so eighteen dollars there.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn waɪts soʊ ˌeɪˈtin ˈdɑlɚz ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 九盤白的，所以那組是十八元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eighteen, plus sixteen from the black.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌeɪˈtin plʌs ˌsɪksˈtin frʌm ðə blæk/
dialogue.zh: 十八，再加上黑色那組的十六。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixteen for four black plates, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌsɪksˈtin fɔr fɔr blæk pleɪts jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 四盤黑色就是十六元，沒錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue is ten, two plates at five.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu ɪz tɛn tu pleɪts æt faɪv/
dialogue.zh: 藍色那組十元，兩盤各五元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the gold one adds eight more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ɡoʊld wʌn ædz eɪt mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 金色那一盤再加八元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So your total is fifty-two dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ jɔr ˈtoʊtəl ɪz ˌfɪfti tu ˈdɑlɚz/
dialogue.zh: 所以你們總共是五十二元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifty-two, that is fair for tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌfɪfti tu ðæt ɪz fɛr fɔr təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 五十二元，今晚這樣很合理。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tax is inside, the card says so.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæks ɪz ɪnˈsaɪd ðə kɑrd sɛz soʊ/
dialogue.zh: 稅金已經含在裡面，單子上有寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No extra service charge, thank goodness.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈɛkstrə ˈsɜrvɪs tʃɑrdʒ θæŋk ˈɡʊdnɪs/
dialogue.zh: 沒有額外的服務費，謝天謝地。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: None here, we pay one price only.
dialogue.phonetic: /nʌn hɪr wi peɪ wʌn praɪs ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 我們這裡沒有，只付一個價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we have one bill or two bills?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi hæv wʌn bɪl ɔr tu bɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 我們要一張帳單還是兩張？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two slips, one for you, one for her.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu slɪps wʌn fɔr ju wʌn fɔr hɜr/
dialogue.zh: 兩張單，你的、她的，各一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, my wife pays her own share.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt maɪ waɪf peɪz hɜr oʊn ʃɛr/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我太太付她自己的那一份。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very common here, no awkward feeling.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛri ˈkɑmən hɪr noʊ ˈɔkwɚd ˈfilɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡很常見，不會尷尬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, her stack looks shorter than mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt hɚ stæk lʊks ˈʃɔrtər ðæn maɪn/
dialogue.zh: 等等，她那一疊看起來比我的矮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hers is only two, yours is the tall one.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜrz ɪz ˈoʊnli tu jʊrz ɪz ðə tɔl wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 她那邊只有兩盤，你這一疊才是高的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me count my white plates again.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi kaʊnt maɪ waɪt pleɪts əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 讓我再數一次我的白盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, the belt keeps moving.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jɔr taɪm ðə bɛlt kips ˈmuvɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢數，回轉帶還在跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I count eight whites, not nine, chef.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kaʊnt eɪt waɪts nɑt naɪn ʃɛf/
dialogue.zh: 我數到八盤白的，不是九盤，師傅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, one white is under the tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru wʌn waɪt ɪz ˈʌndɚ ðə treɪ/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，有一盤白盤在托盤下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Under the tray? That is a new one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndɚ ðə treɪ ðæt ɪz ə nu wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 托盤下面？這我倒是第一次遇到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will fix the slip, one second now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl fɪks ðə slɪp wʌn ˈsɛkənd naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我馬上改單子，請等我一秒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So two dollars back, that is honest.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ tu ˈdɑlɚz bæk ðæt ɪz ˈɑnɪst/
dialogue.zh: 所以要退兩元，這樣很誠實。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifty now, thank you for checking.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪfti naʊ θæŋk ju fɔr ˈtʃɛkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 現在是五十元，謝謝你核對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifty, I can pay with my card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪfti aɪ kæn peɪ wɪð maɪ kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 五十元，我可以用卡付。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The machine sits at the front door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə məˈʃin sɪts æt ðə frʌnt dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 讀卡機就在門口那台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I tap it or hand it to you?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ tæp ɪt ɔr hænd ɪt tu ju/
dialogue.zh: 我是感應付款還是把卡交給你？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap it here, small beep, then done.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp ɪt hɪr smɔl bip ðɛn dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡感應一下，嗶一聲就好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Beep, and that is how you pay here?
dialogue.phonetic: /bip ænd ðæt ɪz haʊ ju peɪ hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 嗶，你們這裡是這樣付款的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is it, no signing on this one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ɪt noʊ ˈsaɪnɪŋ ɑn ðɪs wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，這張不用簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, my phone can pay too, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs maɪ foʊn kæn peɪ tu raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 真好，我手機也能付，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the code on the wall works too.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə koʊd ɑn ðə wɔl wɜrks tu/
dialogue.zh: 對，牆上那個條碼也可以掃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I just scan the code on the wall?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ dʒʌst skæn ðə koʊd ɑn ðə wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 所以我用手機掃牆上那個條碼就好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Point your phone at it, and it pays.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɔɪnt jɔr foʊn æt ɪt ænd ɪt peɪz/
dialogue.zh: 把手機對著它，錢就付了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, that took three seconds.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðæt tʊk θri ˈsɛkəndz/
dialogue.zh: 哇，這樣就三秒搞定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cash guests wait in line, sometimes.
dialogue.phonetic: /kæʃ ɡɛsts weɪt ɪn laɪn ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 用現金的客人有時候要排隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For her half, she brings coins, is that fine?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr hɜr hæf ʃi brɪŋz kɔɪnz ɪz ðæt faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 她那一份她想付硬幣，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coins are fine, the jar sits over there.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔɪnz ɑr faɪn ðə dʒɑr sɪts ˈoʊvɚ ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 硬幣可以，那個罐子就在那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pennies too, or only big coins?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɛniz tu ɔr ˈoʊnli bɪɡ kɔɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 一分的也收嗎，還是只收大的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pennies are welcome, we give change.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɛniz ɑr ˈwɛlkəm wi ɡiv tʃeɪndʒ/
dialogue.zh: 小額硬幣也歡迎，我們會找錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Change? You give paper money back?
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃeɪndʒ ju ɡiv ˈpeɪpɚ ˈmʌni bæk/
dialogue.zh: 找錢？你會退紙鈔給我？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you pay more than the bill.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf ju peɪ mɔr ðæn ðə bɪl/
dialogue.zh: 只在你付超過帳單金額的時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have ten ones here, is that okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv tɛn wʌnz hɪr ɪz ðæt oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我這邊有十張一元，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten ones, that is her half exactly.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn wʌnz ðæt ɪz hɜr hæf ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 十枚一元，剛好是她那一份。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then ten in cash, and my part on card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tɛn ɪn kæʃ ænd maɪ pɑrt ɑn kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 那她現金十元，我的那份刷卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can do that, one tap, one bill.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn du ðæt wʌn tæp wʌn bɪl/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以這樣做，感應一次、收現金一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I get a paper for my wallet?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ ɡɛt ə ˈpeɪpɚ fɔr maɪ ˈwɑlɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我會拿到一張收據放錢包嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The slip prints at the door, take one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə slɪp prɪnts æt ðə dɔr teɪk wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 單子從門口那台印出來，拿一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It shows every color and price.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ʃoʊz ˈɛvri ˈkʌlɚ ænd praɪs/
dialogue.zh: 上面列著每種顏色和它的價格。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four lines, so you can check at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr laɪnz soʊ ju kæn tʃɛk æt hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 四行，你回家也能對得清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four lines, and tea is not one of them.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr laɪnz ænd ti ɪz nɑt wʌn ʌv ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 四行，而且茶不在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tea is free, so it never prints.
dialogue.phonetic: /ti ɪz fri soʊ ɪt ˈnɛvɚ prɪnts/
dialogue.zh: 茶是免費的，所以不會印出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That explains the happy little slip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪkˈspleɪnz ðə ˈhæpi ˈlɪtəl slɪp/
dialogue.zh: 難怪這張小單看著讓人開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We also do not count the joke plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈɔlsoʊ du nɑt kaʊnt ðə dʒok pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我們也不把那個搞笑盤算進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The orange one, still free tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɔrɪndʒ wʌn stɪl fri təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 橘色那個，今晚還是免費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For a child, yes, that one is a gift.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ə tʃaɪld jɛs ðæt wʌn ɪz ə ɡɪft/
dialogue.zh: 給小朋友的話是的，那個是送的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He is with us tonight, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ɪz wɪð ʌs təˈnaɪt θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 他今晚就跟我們在一起，謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then keep the tag, and come back next month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn kip ðə tæɡ ænd kʌm bæk nɛkst mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 那這個標籤你留著，下個月再來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next month, we will bring the whole family.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst mʌnθ wi wɪl brɪŋ ðə hoʊl ˈfæməli/
dialogue.zh: 下個月我們會把全家帶來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five people? Then take the long table.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈpipəl ðɛn teɪk ðə lɔŋ ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 五位嗎？那我們準備那張長桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, may I ask about the tip?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ meɪ aɪ æsk əˈbaʊt ðə tɪp/
dialogue.zh: 對了，我可以問小費的事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No tip box here, the price is kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ tɪp bɑks hɪr ðə praɪs ɪz kaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 我們沒有小費箱，價位已經很厚道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will pay the exact number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl peɪ ði ɪɡˈzækt ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那我就付剛剛好的金額。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can round up, if you feel like it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn raʊnd ʌp ɪf ju fil laɪk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你想的話也可以往上進位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Round up, that is my way to thank.
dialogue.phonetic: /raʊnd ʌp ðæt ɪz maɪ weɪ tu θæŋk/
dialogue.zh: 往上進位，那是我道謝的方式。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will remember it, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl rɪˈmɛmbɚ ɪt θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 我會記著的，謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, the two blue plates were mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ðə tu blu pleɪts wɜr maɪn/
dialogue.zh: 等等，那兩盤藍色是我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hers, but the gold one was yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜrz bʌt ðə ɡoʊld wʌn wʌz jɔrz/
dialogue.zh: 那是她的，不過金色那盤是你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then my half should be a bit less.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn maɪ hæf ʃʊd bi ə bɪt lɛs/
dialogue.zh: 那我那一半應該要少一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me add it slow, one moment.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi æd ɪt sloʊ wʌn ˈmoʊmənt/
dialogue.zh: 讓我慢慢加一次，稍等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No hurry, we have all evening here.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈhɜri wi hæv ɔl ˈivnɪŋ hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 不急，我們整個晚上都有時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty for you, ten for her.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti fɔr ju tɛn fɔr hɜr/
dialogue.zh: 你四十元，她十元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty, I knew I ate the most.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti aɪ nju aɪ et ðə moʊst/
dialogue.zh: 四十元，我就知道我吃得最多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The most plates, and the most talk too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə moʊst pleɪts ænd ðə moʊst tɔk tu/
dialogue.zh: 盤子吃得最多，話也講最多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Guilty, the belt is a talking place.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɪlti ðə bɛlt ɪz ə ˈtɔkɪŋ pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 我認錯，回轉帶邊就是愛聊天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, but tonight the count was clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru bʌt təˈnaɪt ðə kaʊnt wʌz klin/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，不過今晚算得很清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clean count, no plate lost in the slot.
dialogue.phonetic: /klin kaʊnt noʊ pleɪt lɔst ɪn ðə slɑt/
dialogue.zh: 算得很乾淨，沒有一盤掉進洞口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The slot and the table said the same.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə slɑt ænd ðə ˈteɪbəl sɛd ðə seɪm/
dialogue.zh: 洞口的數量和桌上的數對得起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do you keep the numbers right?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du ju kip ðə ˈnʌmbɚz raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你怎麼把數字都記得這麼對？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Colors, only colors, that is all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌlɚz ˈoʊnli ˈkʌlɚz ðæt ɪz ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 靠顏色，只靠顏色，就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Colors are easy, names are the hard part.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌlɚz ɑr ˈizi neɪmz ɑr ðə hɑrd pɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 顏色很容易，名字才是難的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fish names are hard for me too.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪʃ neɪmz ɑr hɑrd fɔr mi tu/
dialogue.zh: 魚的名字對我也很難。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you count the plates for table four?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju kaʊnt ðə pleɪts fɔr ˈteɪbəl fɔr/
dialogue.zh: 你幫四號桌數過盤子了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, the belt is still feeding them.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt ðə bɛlt ɪz stɪl ˈfidɪŋ ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 還沒，回轉帶還在給他們上盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, our slip is done, look here.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ˈaʊər slɪp ɪz dʌn lʊk hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 好，我們的單子算完了，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen plates, one gold, tea for free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌfɪfˈtin pleɪts wʌn ɡoʊld ti fɔr fri/
dialogue.zh: 十五盤，含一盤金色，茶免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifteen plates, I cannot believe that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌfɪfˈtin pleɪts aɪ ˈkænɑt bɪˈliv ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 十五盤，我簡直不敢相信。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You said stop at ten, you did not.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju sɛd stɑp æt tɛn ju dɪd nɑt/
dialogue.zh: 你原本說吃到十盤就停，結果沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, the slot is still full.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr θɪŋ ðə slɑt ɪz stɪl fʊl/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，那個洞口已經塞滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave it, we empty it after ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ɪt wi ˈɛmpti ɪt ˈæftɚ tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 放著吧，我們十點以後才清。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We cannot finish these three plates.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈkænɑt ˈfɪnɪʃ ðiz θri pleɪts/
dialogue.zh: 我們吃不完這三盤了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Would you like me to box them?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju laɪk mi tu bɑks ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 要我幫您把它們裝盒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, can raw fish travel in a box?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs kæn rɔ fɪʃ ˈtrævəl ɪn ə bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 可以，生的魚用盒子裝能帶走嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but keep it cold and eat soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt kip ɪt koʊld ænd it sun/
dialogue.zh: 可以，但要保持冰涼，趕快吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How soon is soon, one hour or two?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ sun ɪz sun wʌn ˈaʊər ɔr tu/
dialogue.zh: 多快算快，一小時還是兩小時？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two hours, after that it is not fresh.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈaʊərz ˈæftɚ ðæt ɪt ɪz nɑt frɛʃ/
dialogue.zh: 兩小時，之後就不算新鮮了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will walk straight home today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl wɔk streɪt hoʊm təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那我今天就一路直接走回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or I can add a small ice pack.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔr aɪ kæn æd ə smɔl aɪs pæk/
dialogue.zh: 或者我可以幫你放一個小冰袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An ice pack, inside the paper bag?
dialogue.phonetic: /ən aɪs pæk ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈpeɪpɚ bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 冰袋就放在紙袋裡面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under the box, the bag keeps it cool.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndɚ ðə bɑks ðə bæɡ kips ɪt kul/
dialogue.zh: 放在盒子下面，紙袋能保持涼意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is smart, our walk home is long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz smɑrt ˈaʊər wɔk hoʊm ɪz lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那很聰明，我們回家的路很長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then carry the box with both hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈkæri ðə bɑks wɪð boʊθ hændz/
dialogue.zh: 那你就用兩手捧著盒子走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a bigger box than this?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ə ˈbɪɡɚ bɑks ðæn ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 你們有比這個更大的盒子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The long one fits six rolls easily.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɔŋ wʌn fɪts sɪks roʊlz ˈizəli/
dialogue.zh: 長條那款輕鬆裝得下六卷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six rolls, that is my whole table.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks roʊlz ðæt ɪz maɪ hoʊl ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 六卷，那差不多是我整桌的量。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will slide the eel pieces in first.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl slaɪd ði il ˈpisɪz ɪn fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 我會先把鰻魚那幾塊滑進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please keep the sauce on the side.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz kip ðə sɔs ɑn ðə saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 請把醬另外放，不要淋上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small cup with a lid, right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl kʌp wɪð ə lɪd raɪt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 一個有蓋子的小杯，就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A lid, good, my bag leaks sometimes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə lɪd ɡʊd maɪ bæɡ liks ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 有蓋最好，我的袋子偶爾會漏。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the cup goes in a second bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə kʌp ɡoʊz ɪn ə ˈsɛkənd bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 那醬杯就再套第二個袋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I also take the wasabi home?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ teɪk ðə wɑˈsɑbi hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 山葵我也可以帶回家嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A tiny packet, folded in paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈtaɪni ˈpækɪt ˈfoʊldɪd ɪn ˈpeɪpɚ/
dialogue.zh: 一小包，用紙折起來給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paper, not plastic? I like that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpɚ nɑt ˈplæstɪk aɪ laɪk ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 用紙不用塑膠？我喜歡這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The paper breathes, the fish stays dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈpeɪpɚ brɪðz ðə fɪʃ steɪz draɪ/
dialogue.zh: 紙會透氣，魚就不會濕濕的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I get chopsticks for the road?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ ɡɛt ˈtʃɑpˌstɪks fɔr ðə roʊd/
dialogue.zh: 路上用的筷子也會給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two pairs, wrapped, in the top corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu pɛrz ræpt ɪn ðə tɑp ˈkɔrnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 兩雙筷子，包好了，放在最上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two pairs, and my son needs a fork.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu pɛrz ænd maɪ sɑn nidz ə fɔrk/
dialogue.zh: 兩雙，可是我兒子需要叉子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One small fork, I placed it already.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn smɔl fɔrk aɪ pleɪst ɪt ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 一支小叉子，我已經先放好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You placed it? You think of everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju pleɪst ɪt ju θɪŋk ʌv ˈɛvriθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 你就放好了？你什麼都想到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rolls fall apart without a small fork.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊlz fɔl əˈpɑrt wɪˈðaʊt ə smɔl fɔrk/
dialogue.zh: 沒有小叉子，卷很容易就散開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True, my daughter ate with her hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru maɪ ˈdɔtɚ et wɪð hɜr hændz/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，我女兒剛剛都是用手吃的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the sauce will be messy at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə sɔs wɪl bi ˈmɛsi æt hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 那回家時醬就會弄得很亂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Messy is fine, she is six years old.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛsi ɪz faɪn ʃi ɪz sɪks jɪrz oʊld/
dialogue.zh: 亂一點沒關係，她才六歲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six is a great age for soy sauce.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ɪz ə ɡreɪt edʒ fɔr sɔɪ sɔs/
dialogue.zh: 六歲正是最適合玩醬油的年紀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, then give her the last roll.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðɛn ɡiv hɜr ðə læst roʊl/
dialogue.zh: 哈，那最後一卷就給她吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cucumber one? It is still cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkjumˌbɚ wʌn ɪt ɪz stɪl koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 小黃瓜那捲嗎？它還是冰冰的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, cucumber travels well, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈkjumˌbɚ ˈtrævəlz wɛl aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 對，我覺得小黃瓜卷很耐帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It does, the crunch stays for hours.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dʌz ðə krʌntʃ steɪz fɔr ˈaʊərz/
dialogue.zh: 真的會，脆脆的口感能撐好幾小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the tempura, does it work?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə tɛmˈpurə dʌz ɪt wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 那天婦羅呢，也能裝盒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the fried part goes soft in a box.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə fraɪd pɑrt ɡoʊz sɔft ɪn ə bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 不行，炸的那部分在盒裡會變軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So we eat the fried one right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi it ðə fraɪd wʌn raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 所以炸的我們要現在就吃掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, paper kills the crisp sound.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ˈpeɪpɚ kɪlz ðə krɪsp saʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 對了，紙袋會殺掉那種脆脆的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kills the crisp, that is a sad truth.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɪlz ðə krɪsp ðæt ɪz ə sæd truθ/
dialogue.zh: 殺掉脆感，這真是個悲哀的事實。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But the eel roll comes back to life.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ði il roʊl kʌmz bæk tu laɪf/
dialogue.zh: 但鰻魚卷回家後會活過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really, the cold eel is still good?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪli ðə koʊld il ɪz stɪl ɡʊd/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎，冷掉的鰻魚還很好吃？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm it ten seconds, that is all.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm ɪt tɛn ˈsɛkəndz ðæt ɪz ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 加熱十秒就好了，就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten seconds in the microwave, fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈsɛkəndz ɪn ðə ˈmaɪkrəˌweɪv faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 微波十秒，了解。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or eat it cold, many people do.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔr it ɪt koʊld ˈmɛni ˈpipəl du/
dialogue.zh: 或者冷的吃也可以，很多人都這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I take the ginger as well?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ teɪk ðə ˈdʒɪndʒɚ æz wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 薑我也可以帶一些走嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The wooden box stays, we wash it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwʊdən bɑks steɪz wi wɑʃ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 木盒要留下來，我們要洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The box is yours, I understand now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɑks ɪz jɔrz aɪ ˌʌndɚˈstænd naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 盒子是你們的，我現在明白了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the ginger in a paper corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə ˈdʒɪndʒɚ ɪn ə ˈpeɪpɚ ˈkɔrnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 薑我用紙折一個角給你帶走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One paper corner, that is fair.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈpeɪpɚ ˈkɔrnɚ ðæt ɪz fɛr/
dialogue.zh: 用紙折一個角，這樣很公道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We give paper, never more boxes.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɡiv ˈpeɪpɚ ˈnɛvɚ mɔr ˈbɑksɪz/
dialogue.zh: 我們給紙，不會再多給盒子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about those little sauce dishes?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ðoz ˈlɪtəl sɔs ˈdɪʃɪz/
dialogue.zh: 那些裝醬油的小碟子呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They stay on the belt, I am sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ steɪ ɑn ðə bɛlt aɪ æm ˈsɑri/
dialogue.zh: 它們要留在回轉帶上，不好意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry for what, I only asked once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri fɔr wʌt aɪ ˈoʊnli æskt wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 你道什麼歉，我只問了一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The dishes carry numbers, we need them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɪʃɪz ˈkæri ˈnʌmbɚz wi nid ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 那些碟子上有編號，我們需要收回。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Numbered dishes? That is new to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌmbɚd ˈdɪʃɪz ðæt ɪz nu tu mi/
dialogue.zh: 碟子有編號？這我是第一次聽說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every plate has a number under it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri pleɪt hæz ə ˈnʌmbɚ ˈʌndɚ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 每個盤子底下都有一個編號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Under the plate? I never looked there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndɚ ðə pleɪt aɪ ˈnɛvɚ lʊkt ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 盤子下面？我從來沒去看那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn one over, the stamp is small.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn wʌn ˈoʊvɚ ðə stæmp ɪz smɔl/
dialogue.zh: 翻一個看看，那個印章很小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here, a tiny eight under my blue.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ə ˈtaɪni eɪt ˈʌndɚ maɪ blu/
dialogue.zh: 真的有，我藍色盤下面一個小小的八。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That number is how we count stacks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈnʌmbɚ ɪz haʊ wi kaʊnt stæks/
dialogue.zh: 我們就是靠那個數字數一疊盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the plates are not free to take.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə pleɪts ɑr nɑt fri tu teɪk/
dialogue.zh: 所以盤子不是可以隨便拿走的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But the orange one is yours to keep.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ði ˈɔrɪndʒ wʌn ɪz jʊrz tu kip/
dialogue.zh: 不過橘色那個盤子可以送你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The joke one? You gave me that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dʒok wʌn ju ɡeɪv mi ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 搞笑的那個盤？是你送我的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I say a joke plate needs a home.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ seɪ ə dʒok pleɪt nidz ə hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 我是說，搞笑的盤子也需要一個家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then it sits on my shelf at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɪt sɪts ɑn maɪ ʃɛlf æt hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 那它就擺在我家的架子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wrap it in paper, it can break.
dialogue.phonetic: /ræp ɪt ɪn ˈpeɪpɚ ɪt kæn breɪk/
dialogue.zh: 用紙包好吧，它會摔破。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wrap the plate and the food together?
dialogue.phonetic: /ræp ðə pleɪt ænd ðə fʊd təˈɡɛðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 盤子和食物一起包起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, in two separate paper squares.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɪn tu ˈsɛpərət ˈpeɪpɚ skwɛrz/
dialogue.zh: 不，分成兩張方紙分開包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two squares, that is very careful.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu skwɛrz ðæt ɪz ˈvɛri ˈkɛrfəl/
dialogue.zh: 兩張方紙，你也太仔細了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I learned it with my own cup here.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lɜrnd ɪt wɪð maɪ oʊn kʌp hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 這是我的杯子在這裡學到的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your own cup broke in this bar?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr oʊn kʌp broʊk ɪn ðɪs bɑr/
dialogue.zh: 你自己的杯子在這個店破過？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Last year, and the belt kept moving.
dialogue.phonetic: /læst jɪr ænd ðə bɛlt kept ˈmuvɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 去年，而回轉帶照樣在跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is the sushi bar way, truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə ˈsuʃi bɑr weɪ ˈtruli/
dialogue.zh: 這大概就是壽司店的作風。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nobody stops eating for one crack.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊˌbɑdi stɑps ˈitɪŋ fɔr wʌn kræk/
dialogue.zh: 不會因為一個裂聲就停下不吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much do I pay for packing?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ du aɪ peɪ fɔr ˈpækɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 打包要收多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing, the box is free with a meal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ ðə bɑks ɪz fri wɪð ə mil/
dialogue.zh: 不收費，點餐就能免費用盒子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free box, I must remember that.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri bɑks aɪ mʌst rɪˈmɛmbɚ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 免費的盒子，這個我要記住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell your friends, they always ask me.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl jɔr frɛndz ðeɪ ˈɔlweɪz æsk mi/
dialogue.zh: 跟你朋友說，他們老是問我這件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will, can you cut the big roll?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kæn ju kʌt ðə bɪɡ roʊl/
dialogue.zh: 我會說，可以幫我把大卷切開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cut in half, so it fits two boxes.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌt ɪn hæf soʊ ɪt fɪts tu ˈbɑksɪz/
dialogue.zh: 切成兩半，剛好放進兩個盒子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two boxes, one is for my neighbor.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈbɑksɪz wʌn ɪz fɔr maɪ ˈneɪbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 兩個盒子，一個是給我鄰居的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She will thank you with her own roll.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi wɪl θæŋk ju wɪð hɜr oʊn roʊl/
dialogue.zh: 她一定會用她自己那捲回謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her rolls are bad, honestly speaking.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜr roʊlz ɑr bæd ˈɑnəstli ˈspikɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 她做的卷很難吃，老實說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then swap only the tuna part back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn swɑp ˈoʊnli ðə ˈtunə pɑrt bæk/
dialogue.zh: 那你就只把鮪魚那部分換回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only the tuna, that is the rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ðə ˈtunə ðæt ɪz ðə rul/
dialogue.zh: 只換鮪魚，這就是規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your boxes are closed, here is the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈbɑksɪz ɑr kloʊzd hɪr ɪz ðə bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 你的盒子都封好了，袋子給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bag handle looks strong enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bæɡ ˈhændəl lʊks strɔŋ ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 這個提把看起來夠結實。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It holds ten plates, I tested it once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hoʊldz tɛn pleɪts aɪ ˈtɛstɪd ɪt wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 它撐得住十個盤子的重量，我試過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You tested a bag with ten plates?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈtɛstɪd ə bæɡ wɪð tɛn pleɪts/
dialogue.zh: 你們用十個盤子測試袋子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every Friday we test one new bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri ˈfraɪdeɪ wi tɛst wʌn nu bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 每個星期五我們都測一個新袋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This shop has rules for everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ʃɑp hæz rulz fɔr ˈɛvriθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 這家店什麼事都有規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For bags, boxes, and the cold fish.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr bæɡz ˈbɑksɪz ænd ðə koʊld fɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 袋子、盒子，還有冷的魚都有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a receipt for the box?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ə rɪˈsit fɔr ðə bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 我需要收據證明我打包了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The slip says boxed, that is proof.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə slɪp sɛz bɑkst ðæt ɪz pruf/
dialogue.zh: 單子上寫了打包，那就是證明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Boxed on paper, a perfect night.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɑkst ɑn ˈpeɪpɚ ə ˈpɜrfɪkt naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 白紙上寫著打包，今晚太完美了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get home safe, the belt waits tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɛt hoʊm seɪf ðə bɛlt weɪts təˈmɑroʊ/
dialogue.zh: 回家路上小心，明天回轉帶還在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before we leave, I want to say this.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔr wi liv aɪ wɑnt tu seɪ ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 在我們走之前，我想說這句話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say it slow, I am listening now.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ɪt sloʊ aɪ æm ˈlɪsənɪŋ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢說，我在聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was the best meal all month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌz ðə bɛst mil ɔl mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 這是我這個月最好吃的一餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will smile, I never stop moving.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl smaɪl aɪ ˈnɛvɚ stɑp ˈmuvɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我會笑的，我從頭到尾都在動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fish was so fresh tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fɪʃ wʌz soʊ frɛʃ təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚的魚實在太新鮮了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I buy it every morning at five.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ baɪ ɪt ˈɛvri ˈmɔrnɪŋ æt faɪv/
dialogue.zh: 我每天早上五點就去進貨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five in the morning, at the market?
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ æt ðə ˈmɑrkɪt/
dialogue.zh: 早上五點，就去魚市場嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I pick the boxes by hand only.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ pɪk ðə ˈbɑksɪz baɪ hænd ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 我只用自己的手一箱箱挑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No machine picks the fish for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ məˈʃin pɪks ðə fɪʃ fɔr ju/
dialogue.zh: 沒有機器幫你選魚嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, my nose chooses it first.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ maɪ noʊz ˈtʃuzɪz ɪt fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我先用鼻子聞過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That explains the taste on my plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪkˈspleɪnz ðə teɪst ɑn maɪ pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這就解釋了我盤子上的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do, I love to hear that.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du aɪ lʌv tu hɪr ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 請多說，我愛聽這句。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chef, the eel with the fire was perfect.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɛf ði il wɪð ðə faɪr wʌz ˈpɜrfɪkt/
dialogue.zh: 師傅，用火烤的那道鰻魚太完美了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You mean the gold plate at seven?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju min ðə ɡoʊld pleɪt æt ˈsɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 你說的是七點那盤金色的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, that one, I still taste it now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðæt wʌn aɪ stɪl teɪst ɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 對，就是那盤，我現在還有那個味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We only make it on Friday nights.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈoʊnli meɪk ɪt ɑn ˈfraɪdeɪ naɪts/
dialogue.zh: 我們只在星期五晚上做那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I came on the right night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ keɪm ɑn ðə raɪt naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那我今晚來對日子了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You did, the belt knows your face.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju dɪd ðə bɛlt noʊz jɔr feɪs/
dialogue.zh: 你來對了，回轉帶都認得你的臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The belt knows my face, what a line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛlt noʊz maɪ feɪs wʌt ə laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 回轉帶認得我的臉，這話說得真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You said it first, I only repeat it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju sɛd ɪt fɜrst aɪ ˈoʊnli rɪˈpit ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 是你先說的，我只是學你講。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will say it again next month.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl seɪ ɪt əˈɡɛn nɛkst mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 下個月我還會再說一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring the family, the long table waits.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ðə ˈfæməli ðə lɔŋ ˈteɪbəl weɪts/
dialogue.zh: 把家人帶來，那張長桌會留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five of us, is that a problem?
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ʌv ʌs ɪz ðæt ə ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 我們五個人，這樣會有問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, we count extra plates.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈprɑbləm wi kaʊnt ˈɛkstrə pleɪts/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，我們就多數幾個盤子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: More plates means more work for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɔr pleɪts minz mɔr wɜrk fɔr ju/
dialogue.zh: 盤子多，對你工作就更重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: More plates means a happy chef.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɔr pleɪts minz ə ˈhæpi ʃɛf/
dialogue.zh: 盤子多，代表師傅今天開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is the nicest thing today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə ˈnaɪsɪst θɪŋ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這是今天聽過最暖的一句話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, your bag is still by the seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt jɔr bæɡ ɪz stɪl baɪ ðə sit/
dialogue.zh: 等一下，你的包包還留在座位邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, I almost walked out twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ aɪ ˈɔlmoʊst wɔkt aʊt twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 喔，我差點走了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice is fine, we kept it right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs ɪz faɪn wi kɛpt ɪt raɪt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 兩次也沒關係，我們幫你收好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tea was warm the whole time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ti wʌz wɔrm ðə hoʊl taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 茶從頭到尾都是溫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We refill without asking, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi riˈfɪl wɪˈðaʊt ˈæskɪŋ ˈɔlweɪz/
dialogue.zh: 我們都是不用問就幫你添。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is the part I will miss.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə pɑrt aɪ wɪl mɪs/
dialogue.zh: 這一點是我還會想念的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come tomorrow, the pot is hot again.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm təˈmɑroʊ ðə pɑt ɪz hɑt əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 明天來，茶壺又會燒熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow I bring my brother, he eats ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑroʊ aɪ brɪŋ maɪ ˈbrʌðɚ hi its tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 明天我帶我弟弟來，他能吃十盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten is small here, we like big counts.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ɪz smɔl hɪr wi laɪk bɪɡ kaʊnts/
dialogue.zh: 十盤在這裡算小的，我們愛大數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He will be happy to hear that.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi wɪl bi ˈhæpi tu hɪr ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 他聽到這個一定會很高興。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell him the white plate is waiting.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɪm ðə waɪt pleɪt ɪz ˈweɪtɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 跟他說白色盤子已經在等他了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do you say when the meal ends?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt du ju seɪ wɛn ðə mil ɛndz/
dialogue.zh: 用餐結束時你們會說什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A long Japanese word, thanks for the food.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə lɔŋ ˌdʒæpəˈniz wɜrd θæŋks fɔr ðə fʊd/
dialogue.zh: 一句很長的日文，意思是謝謝這餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for the food, I can say that.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fɔr ðə fʊd aɪ kæn seɪ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝這餐，這句我會說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say it here, I will give a bow.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ɪt hɪr aɪ wɪl ɡiv ə baʊ/
dialogue.zh: 就在這裡說，我會鞠躬的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You bow, I did not see that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju baʊ aɪ dɪd nɑt si ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 你會鞠躬，我剛剛都沒看到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small bows, quick, then back to work.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl baʊz kwɪk ðɛn bæk tu wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 小小的鞠躬，很快，然後繼續工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a beautiful small habit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə ˈbjutəfəl smɔl ˈhæbɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那個小動作真的很美。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is mine, I do it every night here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz maɪn aɪ du ɪt ˈɛvri naɪt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 那是我自己的習慣，每晚都這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every night, chef, you never skip it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri naɪt ʃɛf ju ˈnɛvɚ skɪp ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 師傅，你每晚都不省這一步？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never, the knife and the counter are both mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvɚ ðə naɪf ænd ðə ˈkaʊntɚ ɑr boʊθ maɪn/
dialogue.zh: 當然不省，切魚和吧台兩邊都是我做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both, and you still remembered my son.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ænd ju stɪl rɪˈmɛmbɚd maɪ sɑn/
dialogue.zh: 這樣你還記得我兒子的需求。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The egg roll was his, I wrote it down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɛɡ roʊl wʌz hɪz aɪ roʊt ɪt daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 蛋卷那盤是他的，我寫下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You wrote it down, no wonder it came.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju roʊt ɪt daʊn noʊ ˈwʌndɚ ɪt keɪm/
dialogue.zh: 難怪上得這麼準，你有寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paper beats my tired brain every night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpɚ bits maɪ ˈtaɪərd breɪn ˈɛvri naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 紙張每個晚上都打敗我疲勞的腦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My brain is tired too, I ate fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ breɪn ɪz ˈtaɪərd tu aɪ et ˌfɪfˈtin/
dialogue.zh: 我的腦也累了，我吃了十五盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen, and you still talk straight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌfɪfˈtin ænd ju stɪl tɔk streɪt/
dialogue.zh: 吃十五盤，你說話還是很清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Straight, my mouth is full of rice.
dialogue.phonetic: /streɪt maɪ maʊθ ɪz fʊl ʌv raɪs/
dialogue.zh: 說得直白點，我嘴裡還塞滿了飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the best review I can get.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə bɛst rɪˈvju aɪ kæn ɡɛt/
dialogue.zh: 那就是我能得到的最好評價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is a review, I mean it kindly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ə rɪˈvju aɪ min ɪt ˈkaɪndli/
dialogue.zh: 那就是評價，我是真心的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kind words on a full night, I keep them.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaɪnd wɜrdz ɑn ə fʊl naɪt aɪ kip ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 生意滿滿的晚上聽到好話，我會記著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you write the reviews on a card?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju raɪt ðə rɪˈvjuz ɑn ə kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 你們會把好話寫在卡片上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No cards, we just remember faces.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ kɑrdz wi dʒʌst rɪˈmɛmbɚ ˈfeɪsɪz/
dialogue.zh: 沒有卡片，我們就是記住臉孔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Remembering faces is better than cards.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈmɛmbɚɪŋ ˈfeɪsɪz ɪz ˈbɛtɚ ðæn kɑrdz/
dialogue.zh: 記住臉孔比留卡片更好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Especially the ones who count plates.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈspɛʃəli ði wʌnz hu kaʊnt pleɪts/
dialogue.zh: 尤其是那種會自己數盤子的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The ones who count, that was me tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði wʌnz hu kaʊnt ðæt wʌz mi təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 會數盤子的人，今晚就是我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You counted slow, that is honest work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈkaʊntɪd sloʊ ðæt ɪz ˈɑnɪst wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 你數得很慢，那是誠實的動作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honest is the word for this place.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnɪst ɪz ðə wɜrd fɔr ðɪs pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 誠實這個詞就是在說這間店。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two dollars back when a plate hides.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈdɑlərz bæk wɛn ə pleɪt haɪdz/
dialogue.zh: 盤子躲起來時我們就退兩元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That made me trust the whole slip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt meɪd mi trʌst ðə hoʊl slɪp/
dialogue.zh: 那讓我完全相信那張單子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trust is cheap here, the fish is not.
dialogue.phonetic: /trʌst ɪz tʃip hɪr ðə fɪʃ ɪz nɑt/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡信任很便宜，魚可不是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, good line, I will tell my wife.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɡʊd laɪn aɪ wɪl tɛl maɪ waɪf/
dialogue.zh: 哈，這句話真好，我要告訴我太太。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She already knows, she counted too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɔlˈrɛdi noʊz ʃi ˈkaʊntɪd tu/
dialogue.zh: 她早就知道了，她也跟著數了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She counted my plates behind my back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ˈkaʊntɪd maɪ pleɪts bɪˈhaɪnd maɪ bæk/
dialogue.zh: 她在身後偷偷數我的盤子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mothers count everything, even the tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌðɚz kaʊnt ˈɛvriθɪŋ ˈivɪn ðə ti/
dialogue.zh: 媽媽什麼都數，連茶也不例外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even the free tea, she is right.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivɪn ðə fri ti ʃi ɪz raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 連免費的茶也算，她說得對。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then pay her a compliment on the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn peɪ hɜr ə ˈkɑmpləmənt ɑn ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那回去的路上也誇她一句吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Compliment, yes, that is my plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑmpləmənt jɛs ðæt ɪz maɪ plæn/
dialogue.zh: 誇獎她，對，這就是我的計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You said the food was the best this month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju sɛd ðə fʊd wʌz ðə bɛst ðɪs mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 你說了這是這個月最好吃的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And I will say it at the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd aɪ wɪl seɪ ɪt æt ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 而且我要在門口再說一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The door has ears too, say it twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɔr hæz ɪrz tu seɪ ɪt twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 門口也有耳朵，說兩遍吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twice, then: this chef is a magician.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs ðɛn ðɪs ʃɛf ɪz ə məˈdʒɪʃən/
dialogue.zh: 兩遍，然後說：這位師傅是魔法師。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will hide my face in the rice.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl haɪd maɪ feɪs ɪn ðə raɪs/
dialogue.zh: 我會把臉埋在飯裡害羞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hide in the rice, that is so sweet.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪd ɪn ðə raɪs ðæt ɪz soʊ swit/
dialogue.zh: 埋在飯裡害羞，這太可愛了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I do that when the belt gets loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du ðæt wɛn ðə bɛlt ɡɛts laʊd/
dialogue.zh: 每當回轉帶變吵，我就那樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The belt got loud tonight, we know why.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛlt ɡɑt laʊd təˈnaɪt wi noʊ waɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今晚回轉帶變很吵，我們知道原因。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen plates, one gold, that is why.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌfɪfˈtin pleɪts wʌn ɡoʊld ðæt ɪz waɪ/
dialogue.zh: 十五盤，一盤金色，就是那個原因。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last thing, is the wasabi for sale?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn læst θɪŋ ɪz ðə wɑˈsɑbi fɔr seɪl/
dialogue.zh: 最後一件事，山葵有在賣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The jar, no, but the root, maybe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dʒɑr noʊ bʌt ðə rut ˈmeɪbi/
dialogue.zh: 罐裝的不賣，但整顆根可以賣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe a root, that is a yes for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi ə rut ðæt ɪz ə jɛs fɔr mi/
dialogue.zh: 可以賣根，那我就要買。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will wrap it in two paper squares.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ræp ɪt ɪn tu ˈpeɪpɚ skwɛrz/
dialogue.zh: 我會用兩張方紙包起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two squares, like the plate you saved me.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu skwɛrz laɪk ðə pleɪt ju seɪvd mi/
dialogue.zh: 兩張方紙，就像你留給我那個盤子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same paper, different treasure inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm ˈpeɪpɚ ˈdɪfərənt ˈtrɛʒɚ ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 同樣的紙，裡面是不同的寶物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Treasure, you make a plate sound rich.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtrɛʒɚ ju meɪk ə pleɪt saʊnd rɪtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 你讓一個盤子聽起來好珍貴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tonight it was, your stack said so.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈnaɪt ɪt wʌz jɔr stæk sɛd soʊ/
dialogue.zh: 今晚就是了，你那疊盤子說明了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My stack said a lot, I agree.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ stæk sɛd ə lɑt aɪ əˈɡri/
dialogue.zh: 我那疊盤子真的說明很多，我同意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go home slow, the fish sits heavy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ hoʊm sloʊ ðə fɪʃ sɪts ˈhɛvi/
dialogue.zh: 回家慢點走，那些魚在胃裡很重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heavy and happy, that is my belly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɛvi ænd ˈhæpi ðæt ɪz maɪ ˈbɛli/
dialogue.zh: 又重又快樂，就是我的肚子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the best sushi feeling there is.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə bɛst ˈsuʃi ˈfilɪŋ ðɛr ɪz/
dialogue.zh: 那就是吃壽司最好的感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you next Friday, same counter seat?
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju nɛkst ˈfraɪdeɪ seɪm ˈkaʊntɚ sit/
dialogue.zh: 下星期五見，一樣的吧台座位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The stool is yours, six o'clock sharp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə stul ɪz jɔrz sɪks əˈklɑk ʃɑrp/
dialogue.zh: 那個位子是你的，六點整。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six sharp, and I will bring my own fork.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ʃɑrp ænd aɪ wɪl brɪŋ maɪ oʊn fɔrk/
dialogue.zh: 六點整，我會自備我的叉子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do, we are out of tiny ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du wi ɑr aʊt ʌv ˈtaɪni wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 請自備，我們的小叉子都用完了。
